title: Heart: grow the native organ sample with locally placed daughters
reason: Δproxy +0.02 [-0.10, +0.15] n=8; heart lower bound -0.20 not above 0.5 | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Growing the dissected-heart sample from 3,000 to 7,959 sites by retaining the full native pool plus one locally placed donor-copy daughter per donor moved geometry exactly as designed (median 15th-neighbour distance 30.69 -> 20.59) yet moved no metric: Δproxy +0.02 [-0.10, +0.15] n=8 (z 0.4), heart board +0.05 [-0.20, +0.30], with neighborhood_mmd -0.1 (target >= +1), E9.5 occupancy_dice +0.2 (target >= +2) and E8.75 heart 77.04 -> 76.71 on a D2 shape drop 72.0 -> 64.9. Heart neighbourhood/occupancy error at the parent's 3,000-row draw is not limited by interior sampling density, and daughters that are exact expression copies of their donors add no measurable credit.
mechanism: On dissected heart forecasts (valid latest heart region, positive horizon, no explicit row override), the sample became the full eligible native pool of size m grown to round(m * clip(m/m_prev, 1, 2)**clip(horizon/interval, 0, 1)) capped at 25,179 rows, where each extra row carries a distinct uniformly sampled native mother's unaltered expression and section coordinate displaced uniformly within half the mother's nearest distinct 3D native site distance in the section plane; all other paths (non-dissected, absent crop, nonpositive horizon, explicit overrides) keep the parent sampler.
retry_condition: Not worth racing again as implemented: the seed-101 screen already missed both active predictions and the 8 paired heart diffs straddle zero (-0.64 to +0.47). A retry is justified only if daughters carry genuinely new expression (interpolated or locally noised profiles rather than exact donor copies, so duplicated donors do not over-correlate neighbourhood pseudobulks), or if a multi-seed dev ablation shows neighborhood_mmd/occupancy_dice respond to site count beyond a 3,000-row draw - E9.5 occupancy held ~44 despite 2.7x more sites, suggesting boundary coverage, not interior density, binds.
method_lessons: Mechanism fidelity is not metric response: the sampler hit its design targets (7,959 distinct sites, 15th-neighbour distance 30.69 -> 20.59, daughters inside the half-nearest-site bound) yet the predicted metric signature went 2/4 - both active predictions missed (neighborhood_mmd -0.1 vs >= +1, occupancy_dice +0.2 vs >= +2) while the guards held (mmd_u +0.2, scale_log_ratio +0.1). Verify a metric is density-limited before spending a race on density.

A one-seed dev screen correctly presaged the race: seed 101 showed neighborhood_mmd +0.3 (target >= 1), occupancy -0.1 (target >= 2) and an E8.75 D2 shape drop 72.0 -> 64.9; the paired race returned Δproxy +0.02 [-0.10, +0.15] and heart lower bound -0.20 vs the required > 0.5. Screens that miss every preregistered target are cheap stop signals.

Leaderboard contrast motivates but does not establish causation: PeacyBlose25 (77.1 heart, N25179 rows) vs devalex (73.7, N11547) differ in many design choices, and the near-zero race confirmed the confound warning the hypothesis itself raised.

Seed-pair variance sets the resolution limit: heart diffs ranged -0.64 to +0.47 (SE 0.13), so n=8 cannot resolve a +0.5 to +1.0 board forecast; calibrate preregistered effect sizes against observed pair variance (the accepted w1_c01 rim change won +0.72 at z 7.5 - effect size, not design quality, decided both races).

Scoping was clean: embryo, perturbation and temporal diffs were exactly 0.0 on all 8 pairs, so a heart.py-only change races without contamination; the severity gate's OPEN genes (gata4_1/2, hand2_e825/e925, mef2c_e85) are untouched context, not evidence against this change.
impl_pitfalls: The growth factor clip(m/m_prev, 1, 2) is silently inert when the latest eligible count is not above the previous one - E8.75 kept all 3,630 native sites and emitted zero daughters, so the mechanism only fires on positive eligible-count growth.
A single-site native pool has no measurable displacement scale and must fall back to native rows only.
Larger submissions are not free: at the 25,179-row cap on the five-input E9.5 proxy, RMS worsened slightly (277.13 vs parent 275.09).
The E12.5 export reaching the 25,179 cap depends on the actual (unreleased) E10.5 pool size; only the five-input proxy through E9.5 was verified.
Contract edges must match the parent byte-for-byte: surrounding-tissue, explicit-row-count, zero-horizon and missing-label cases were all checked, and only heart.py changed.

title: Embryo: replicate the confirmed depth-harmonised time-proportional midpoint mixture and place the size from a constant-cell-density growth law
reason: Δproxy +4.95 [+4.81, +5.09] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85 | promotion review veto: Misrepresentation: ws/embryo.py:199 - Once the later bracket becomes the scaffold, the code assigns the elapsed-time weight to the earlier bracket. A synthetic check at fraction 0.75 produced 25% later-stage profiles instead of the claimed 75%, and at fraction 1.0 every profile came from the earlier stage.
lesson: The three input-derived embryo mechanisms acted exactly as intended — embryo board +9.89 vs parent (Δproxy +4.95 [+4.81, +5.09], z +66.8, n=8; 6/6 metric signature: variogram +31.9, mmd_u +15.5, neighborhood_mmd +7.8, scale_log_ratio +58.2, de_direction +1.2, native_occupancy unchanged) — but the change was vetoed because the 'time-proportional' donor weight is not mirrored when the later bracket is the scaffold: at fraction 0.75 the output held 25% later-stage profiles instead of 75%, and at fraction 1.0 every profile came from the earlier stage. The mechanism family (depth-thinned transplant + constant-density radius law + midpoint mixture) is numerically validated; the specific weight assignment must be fixed before it can be promoted.
mechanism: Binomially thin the transplanted later-bracket (E8.0) libraries to the time-interpolated panel detection depth (confirmed w2_c02 recipe), replace log-linear rms-radius interpolation with rms = rms_scaffold*(n_interp/n_scaffold)^(1/3) at constant cell density, and set the donor mixture weight to the elapsed-time fraction (STATE_WARP 0.7 -> 1.0).
retry_condition: Fix the mixture mirroring at ws/embryo.py:199 — on the branch where the later bracket is the scaffold, the donor (earlier-bracket) weight must be 1 - fraction, not fraction — then re-run the identical pre-registered three-mechanism change under the same paired seed protocol; with Δproxy +4.95 and a 6/6 signature even on the mis-mirrored code, the corrected version should confirm.
method_lessons: Numeric confirmation is not semantic confirmation: the paired test showed 6/6 predicted metric moves at z +66.8, yet the code did not implement the claimed time-proportional mixture on the late-scaffold branch; the promotion review's endpoint synthetic checks (fraction 0.75 -> 75% later-stage, fraction 1.0 -> all later-stage) are the right instrument for mixture claims and belong in the contract suite, not just after promotion.

The contract checks covered the no-op path (fraction 0.6 passthrough, detected/cell 35.56 = 0.4*66.4 + 0.6*15.1) but never asserted donor-weight semantics on that same later-scaffold branch — the exact branch that was wrong; test the claim being made, not only the no-op.

Single-seed quick-eval screens overstate paired means (w2_c02: +8.36 screen vs +7.73 paired; here 59.57 screen on a 48.98 parent vs +9.89 paired), so discount screened gains roughly 10% when pre-registering expected paired effects.

The misrepresentation entered through the post-hoc third mechanism (the time-proportional weight, added after the two pre-registered ones on the strength of w2_c00's +2.56 on this seed), not through the pre-registered ones; post-hoc additions need the same adversarial semantic review as pre-registered mechanisms.
impl_pitfalls: ws/embryo.py:199: when scaffold/donor roles swap (fraction > 0.5, later bracket becomes scaffold), the elapsed-time weight was assigned to the earlier-bracket donor, inverting the mixture — fraction 0.75 produced 25% later-stage profiles instead of 75%, fraction 1.0 produced 100% earlier-stage; the donor weight must be mirrored to 1 - fraction on that branch.

thin_transplants returns original donor rows byte-exactly on synthetic passthrough and when the molecule lattice is unresolved, so the fraction-0.6 no-op arm looked fully verified while the weight semantics on that same branch went untested.

Log-linear rms interpolation toward the geometrically non-comparable E8.0 field (rms 326.6, rms/n^(1/3) = 10.32 vs 6.39/6.22 for E6.75/E7.25) overshoots the intermediate radius by 28% (parent 188.4 vs target 147.2); the constant-density cube-root law between the comparable brackets (2.7% density drift) fixed it to +0.017 log radius (prediction 149.8 vs target 147.3).

Radius changes are isolated to scale_log_ratio in this eval frame: occupancy_dice and d2_shape are computed in the rms frame and were bit-identical between radius arms — use this to attribute size-only effects.
claim: On the seed parent (embryo_early dev 48.98) three input-derived, observation-domain corrections raise the embryo board by >= +6 points. (1) Replicating the confirmed w2_c02 depth harmonisation - binomially thinning the transplanted later-bracket (E8.0) transcript libraries to the elapsed-time log-linear interpolated detection depth - raises variogram and mmd_u by >= +10 skill points each and leaves native occupancy unchanged. (2) Replacing the log-linear rms-radius interpolation with a constant-cell-density law (rms scales as the cube root of the interpolated cell count, anchored on the scaffold embryo's own rms and density) moves |scale_log_ratio| from the parent's +0.246 to <0.05 (scale skill 40.8 -> >= 90). (3) Setting the donor mixture weight to the elapsed-time fraction (STATE_WARP 0.7 -> 1.0, the time-proportional midpoint that w2_c00 confirmed on this same seed and that the public recipes describe) must not lose board points on the depth-harmonised mixture; the variogram should gain. Falsifiers: if mmd_u/variogram do not move the donor-depth channel did not act; if the radius stays >10% off the density law is wrong for this bracket pair; if the midpoint weight loses board points at fixed seed it is reverted.

title: T3: Shrink whole-population rollback for unmatched WT lineages
reason: mab21l2 mean change -0.91 below -0.25; Δproxy +2.02 [+1.27, +2.77] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.343 R² 0.18 mag 0.88 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.38 R² 0.29 mag 0.70 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.652 R² 0.16 mag 1.31 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.241 R² 0.35 mag 0.54 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.02 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.681 R² 0.75 mag 0.83 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.04 mag 0.67 | gene-specificity +4.57 (gene-aware)
lesson: Confidence-shrinking the unmatched-lineage WT centroid fallback by shared midpoint mass preserved the c03 port's aggregate gains (paired perturbation delta +2.02 [+1.27,+2.77], z +5.1; Mef2c E8.5 +17.3 with composition TV 0.283->0.177; 4/4 predicted metric signs) but failed the preregistered Mab21l2 knockout guard (-0.91 vs the >=-0.25 floor) and was rejected. At E8.75->E9.5 only 29.9% midpoint mass exists, so the 0.299 multiplier near-removed the fallback (projection 0.051->0.027 vs parent 0.026), implicating the co-ported c03 sampler/exposure/response-budget changes, not the shrunk channel, as the source of the residual Mab21l2 deficit.
mechanism: The w3_c03 GO-backed age-bracket donor law was ported onto the perturbation board, and lineages lacking a supported earlier WT counterpart received the pooled WT centroid tilt at their original dose multiplied by the matched population share across the two WT endpoints (0.299 for Mab21l2 E9.5, affecting 67.7% of later WT rows).
retry_condition: Justified if the confidence factor gets a floor (keeping the fallback projection clearly above the parent's ~0.026), or if E8.75->E9.5 WT matching improves (currently 5 label pairs, 29.9% midpoint mass), or if the port is made conditional on WT support so low-overlap splits keep parent behavior; the Mab21l2 deficit must first be isolated from the co-ported sampler/exposure/response-budget changes via ablation, while keeping the confirmed Mef2c E8.5 bracket (+17.3, TV 0.177, severity R2 0.767).
method_lessons: A significant aggregate win (delta +2.02, CI [+1.27,+2.77], z +5.1, n=8, all eight diffs positive, inside the predicted +1..+3 band) coexisted with a preregistered per-group failure (Mab21l2 -0.91 vs the >=-0.25 guard); the guard, not the z-score, decided the verdict.

Mechanism confirmation is not group-level safety: the predicted signature hit 4/4 (de_score +1.9, de_direction +3.4, mmd_u +4.0, variogram +3.7), de_based gains +1.45, gene-specificity +4.57 (gene-aware), yet Mab21l2 still regressed.

Single-seed quick checks overstated recovery: Mab21l2 gained +4.85 vs w3_c03 on seed 101 (hypothesis asked >=1.3) but averaged -0.91 vs the parent over the race; recovery vs c03 and the guard vs parent are different bars, and c03 itself sat below parent on that split (55.05 vs 61.56).

The severity gate (beta>0 & R2>0.01) separated splits cleanly: five of seven OPEN (best mef2c_e85 beta 0.681, R2 0.75), while mab21l2_e95 (beta 0.001, R2 -0.02) and mef2c_e90 (beta 0.001, R2 -0.04) retained no measurable severity signal.

The candidate-vs-parent race bundles the whole c03 port (age-bracket sampler, WT/GO exposure model, WT-only response budget replacing the dev-derived 0.65 multiplier) plus the shrink, so the -0.91 Mab21l2 deficit cannot be attributed to the fallback shrink alone, whose aggregate projection (0.027) matched the parent (0.026).

Measure WT support before designing dose modulation: E8.5->E8.75 has 31 matched labels and 99.3% midpoint mass (cosine 0.953) while E8.75->E9.5 has 5 pairs and 29.9% (cosine 0.781), so a confidence-weighted late-stage fallback is near a no-op by construction.
impl_pitfalls: A matched-mass multiplier of 0.299 acts as near-removal, not moderation: realised pre-calibration projection fell 0.051->0.027 (parent 0.026) while 67.7% of later WT rows were touched; shrink factors this small need a floor.
The response-calibration budget silently replaced the dev-derived 0.65 multiplier with WT stage contrasts as part of the port, bundling an untested contract change into the same race.
On Mab21l2 the diagnostic composition TV worsened (0.120->0.126) while raw DE recovery/direction improved (0.217->0.246, 0.219->0.253): DE and composition metrics can move oppositely on one split.
Retention guards on weak fits are fragile: the parent Mab21l2 severity was already weak (log beta -6.908, R2 -0.034) and stayed below the gate after the shrink (beta 0.001, R2 -0.02).

No crash traps were hit: only the five perturbation modules changed, and the off-panel Ctnnb1 released-WT call passed all contract checks (7,449 native profiles, GO axis prior 6,853 earlier / 596 later rows, exact seeded reproduction, H5AD write, single-input/incomplete-panel/three-stage cases).
claim: The w3_c03 GO-guided donor law overstates the applicability of a whole-population WT stage contrast to cells whose lineage is absent from one stage. Multiplying only the unmatched-lineage centroid fallback dose by the shared WT midpoint mass should recover at least 1.3 Mab21l2 E9.5 skill points versus w3_c03 in the paired race. The candidate should gain 1.0 to 3.0 perturbation points over the live parent, with every knockout-group delta at least -0.25. For Mef2c E8.5, the age-matched donors should retain a 12 to 20 point gain and cut composition TV by at least 0.05 versus the live parent. Across the board predict +1 to +3 DE recovery and direction skill, and +1 to +4 MMD and variogram skill. If the Mab21l2 guard fails or the predicted DE and composition gains do not materialize, the hypothesis fails.

title: Temporal: half-step unbalanced transport for real cardiac donor selection
reason: Δproxy +0.75 [+0.35, +1.15] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Replicating the public T1 leader tokens (OT50U, CT3, k150) as a half-step unbalanced-transport reweighting of real latest-stage cardiac donors is CONFIRMED: Δproxy +0.75 [+0.35, +1.15] (n=8, z +3.5), all of it on temporal with the other three boards byte-identical at 0.0. The gain landed at the bottom of the preregistered +0.75–2.5 range and came from reweighting measured donors at fixed lineage mass, not from centroid displacement (all three lineage centroid shifts had the expected sign but stayed at +0.005/+0.014/+0.018 SD, below the 0.05-SD falsifier).
mechanism: On the seed parent, kept its peripheral/blood/chamber laws but replaced the cardiac composition law with the w0_c00 three-lineage bounded rule and added per-lineage unbalanced Sinkhorn (12-D PCA, up to 384 anchors per stage, entropy 0.05, marginal penalty 1.0) between the last two stages, subtracting latest-to-latest self-drift, stepping donors at half the elapsed interval capped at one interval within the median radius of their up-to-150 nearest late donors, and reweighting donor selection by a regularized forward/current density ratio clipped to [0.25, 4].

title: Embryo: depth-harmonised transplants and cell-density growth on a time-weighted native scaffold
reason: Δproxy +2.73 [+2.65, +2.81] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Depth-harmonising deep-bracket transplant profiles with the accepted w2_c02 integer-lattice binomial thinning, plus a cube-root cell-count radius law anchored on the nearer scaffold's observed RMS, gained +5.47 embryo board points on the w2_c00 parent (CONFIRMED: Δproxy +2.73 [+2.65, +2.81], z +64.5, n=8) with 5/5 predicted metric signs hit (variogram +26.3, scale_log_ratio +58.2, native_occupancy Dice unchanged at 0.9760) and raw log-radius error cut from +0.246 to +0.005. All gain came from distribution (+4.22) and size (+4.85) metrics; de_based was flat (-0.07) and the heart, perturbation and temporal boards were unmoved.
mechanism: On the w2_c00 parent, deeper-bracket transplant profiles are thinned with the accepted w2_c02 integer-lattice binomial thinning to a log-linearly interpolated panel detection depth (full thinned library normalised before panel projection, byte-exact donor passthrough when inactive or the lattice is unresolvable, later-stage quota computed once as round(n*fraction) with the complement for earlier transplants), and the interpolation radius is the nearer scaffold's observed RMS times the cube root of the log-interpolated-to-scaffold cell-count ratio, preserving dimensionless geometry while allowing a radius change at the scaffold switch.
retry_condition: none
method_lessons: A single-seed dev screen (prediction seed 101, embryo +5.45) predicted the eight-seed paired result (+5.47, Δproxy +2.73, z +64.5) almost exactly, so one quick evaluation was a reliable screen at this effect size.
Preregistering a per-metric signature including an explicit no-change prediction (native_occupancy Dice) made mechanism-as-intended verification sharp: 5/5 signs confirmed.
The bundled paired result estimates the joint thinning-plus-radius change only; per-mechanism attribution would require an ablation.

Auxiliary predictions can be slightly off without harming the main effect: detected genes per emitted cell came in at 19.45 versus the preregistered 20-23 range, and composition TV rose from 0.287 to 0.316, yet board and proxy gains held.

Distribution and size gains need not move DE metrics: de_based was flat (-0.073, de_score unchanged) even though the top-200 pseudobulk magnitude ratio improved from 1.75 to 0.94 and correlation from 0.373 to 0.421 (single-seed diagnostics).

The constant-packing assumption behind the radius law is only approximate (released brackets give RMS over cube-root count of 6.39 versus 6.22); a bracket with different packing or segmentation coverage could bias the inferred radius, and stage-to-stage capture differences may reflect biology or sampling.

Acceptance still carries an OPEN severity gate for five genes (gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41), a caveat for future cycles that this embryo-only change did not address.
No critic feedback was available (plan and code critics disabled by config), so verification rested entirely on preregistered predictions, contract checks and the paired eight-seed test.
impl_pitfalls: Compute the later-stage integer quota once as round(n*fraction) and use its complement for earlier transplants when the later bracket supplies the scaffold; computing quotas independently per bracket can reverse the later-stage share at the scaffold switch (the w2_c05 failure mode).

Lattice resolution failure must fall back to byte-exact donor passthrough, and inactive corrections plus partial-panel inputs must reproduce donor rows byte-for-byte; both paths need explicit byte-equality contract checks.
Apply thinning after the existing donor-to-recipient assignment with a separate prediction-seeded generator, and normalise the full thinned library before projecting to the panel.

Check stage mixture and geometry on both sides of the scaffold switch, at both endpoints and at bracket fractions (50%, 75%, 100%) with synthetic stage markers; the radius can jump at the switch when the brackets imply different packing densities (verified: later stage supplied 751 and 1001 of 1001 profiles at fractions 0.75 and 1.0).

Exercise the fractional test configuration through the frozen dispatcher using released stages only (the E7.25/E8.0 midpoint stand-in reproduced the test's fractions, returning 5000 sites and the 498 input genes, without touching test inputs).
claim: On the w2_c00 parent, depth harmonisation and scaffold-based radius interpolation will jointly improve embryo_early by at least 5 board points. Predict variogram +15 to +30, mmd_u +5 to +15 and neighborhood_mmd +2 to +9 skill points, scale_log_ratio skill above 90 (absolute raw log ratio below 0.05), and native occupancy Dice within 0.002 of the parent. Expect roughly 20–23 detected genes per emitted cell versus roughly 35–37 in the unthinned parent. The later-stage share must equal round(n*fraction) at all bracket fractions, including 50%, 75% and the later endpoint.

signature.summary: signature 5/5: variogram +ok+26.3, mmd_u +ok+5.2, neighborhood_mmd +ok+3.3, scale_log_ratio +ok+58.2, native_occupancy =ok+0.0

leaderboard_evidence: The live embryo top ten had 100 occupancy, 97.3–100 D2 and 98.4–100 scale. title: T3 clean-room d230: GO-breadth-gated developmental delay with lineage-scaled WT borrowing and no amplitude calibration on the delay path
reason: Δproxy +2.13 [+2.10, +2.17] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.629 R² 0.75 mag 0.76 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85 | promotion review veto: Misrepresentation: ws/perturbation_go_delay.py:210 - the zero-draw fallback calls `_diag(reason='zero_draw', w_mean=..., **base)` while `base` already contains `w_mean`, so it raises TypeError instead of returning the parent calibrated output; a gate-positive gene with a small delay weight (e.g. the reserved T3 knockout) would crash rather than take the promised parent path.
lesson: The GO-topology-gated d230 developmental-delay mixture is now thrice-confirmed on the perturbation board (+2.11 in w3_c00 and w3_c04, +2.13 [+2.10,+2.17] z=102.5 n=8 here, 4/5 predicted signature, Mef2c E8.5 68->84) and survives the clean-room rewrite (gate reads only context['external'], no fitted amplitude on the delay path, gate-0 genes byte-identical), yet was again rejected — this time for a one-line bug: the zero-draw fallback passes w_mean twice to _diag and raises TypeError instead of returning the parent output for a gate-positive gene with a small delay weight. The mechanism works; the artifact must return the promised parent path on every branch.
mechanism: A GO-breadth gate (signalling-annotated, non-DNA-binding i.e. no GO:0003700, >=20 co-annotated panel partners, co-expression breadth ramp) routes broad signalling knockouts like the test gene Ctnnb1 to a d230 developmental delay — a lineage-scaled, seeded fraction of output rows replaced by real earlier-stage WT cells with the parent 0.65 amplitude calibration skipped — while all DNA-binding-TF dev knockouts and Mab21l2 get gate 0 and the parent calibrated output byte-identical.
retry_condition: Remove the duplicate keyword at ws/perturbation_go_delay.py:210 (drop the explicit w_mean or pop it from base) so the zero-draw fallback actually returns the parent calibrated output, re-verify every _diag fallback branch executes (zero_draw, earlier_missing_genes, zero_weight) on a gate-positive gene with tiny delay weights, then resubmit; the +2.13 gain and byte-identical guards are on paths unaffected by this fix.
method_lessons: Public T3 recipes correctly predicted the private gain a third time: d230 delay mixtures (t3-x3-d230 78.3, t3-r2-d230 75.6, WT delay composite 73.4) transfer to +2.13 with an extremely tight CI — when a recipe family repeats across independent reimplementation, spend the remaining cycle budget on compliance and code hygiene, not on re-proving the gain.

GO topology alone separates the off-panel test knockout from every dev knockout without touching expression priors: Ctnnb1 has no GO:0003700, 279 panel partners, 0.95 breadth (gate 1.0); Gata4/Hand2/Mef2c all carry GO:0003700 and Mab21l2 has 1 term and 4 partners (gate 0) — this cures the w3_c00/c04 rule violations while keeping guards.

Guard preservation was proven the right way: array SHA-256 byte-identity against the unmodified parent for every gate-0 split, plus a gate-0 control quick_eval reproducing the parent's recorded guard values exactly (gata4_1 63.02, severity beta 0.3327 R2 0.1712).

The honest metric read is 4/5: de_score +2.3, de_direction +3.1, mmd_u +3.5, variogram +2.5 all hit, but severity_slope missed (+1.1) at board level despite the mef2c_e85 single-split severity rising (85.65->93.63); the proxy gain is carried by de_based metrics (+1.54) and distribution (+0.54), size 0.

Promotion review vets every reachable branch, not just those exercised by the dev race: a fallback that never fires on dev genes (zero_draw needs a gate-positive gene with tiny weights, i.e. the reserved test knockout) still vetoed the candidate as misrepresentation — a claimed contract like 'returns the parent output' must hold on all branches.

With the plan and code critics disabled by config, the duplicate-kwarg TypeError passed both reviews; a trivially-crashing fallback is exactly what an enabled code review would have caught, so disabled reviews demand self-executed branch-coverage checks of fallback paths before submission.
impl_pitfalls: ws/perturbation_go_delay.py:210 — _diag(reason='zero_draw', w_mean=float(w_row.mean()), **base) collides with base, which was updated with w_mean at line 202-203; Python raises 'multiple values for keyword argument w_mean' and the gate-positive small-weight gene crashes instead of taking the promised parent path. Always build diagnostic kwargs once (dict.update or explicit overwrite), never pass a key both positionally-in-**base and explicitly.

Prior-cycle compliance traps that this clean-room avoided: reading context['expression_prior'] inside a gate, and leaving a fitted 0.65 amplitude multiplier on any live path, both caused rule-compliance rejection in w3_c00/c04; the compliant pattern is context['external'] only and skipping the inherited calibration entirely on any positive mixture.

An off-panel test gene cannot be dev-raced, so the d230 branch was only validated by a test-configuration simulation (WT E8.5+E8.75 -> Ctnnb1 target 8.75: gate 1.0, w_mean 0.693, 5149/7449 rows replaced, harness.check passes) — simulate the real test inputs before claiming the branch works.

Concatenating parent forecast rows with real earlier-WT donor rows requires obs-column harmonisation and category->str casts for shared columns, and at least one parent row must be kept to avoid an all-donor output.
claim: On the perturbation board, emitting a knockout as a developmentally delayed wild type - a seeded fraction of real earlier-stage WT cells mixed into the parent's real-cell forecast, with the fraction set by elapsed time plus a 0.23-day delay - will (i) reproduce the twice-observed +2.1 board gain on dev (carried by Mef2c E8.5, where the target stage precedes the latest WT input) and (ii) keep every dev knockout gene within the -0.25 guard, because the delay only fires for broad, non-DNA-binding signalling regulators (the test gene Ctnnb1) and the parent composition/calibration path stays byte-identical for the four lineage-restricted DNA-binding TF knockouts and for Mab21l2. No fitted 0.65 amplitude constant is applied anywhere on the delay path.

signature.summary: signature 4/5: de_score +ok+2.3, de_direction +ok+3.1, mmd_u +ok+3.5, variogram +ok+2.5, severity_slope =MISS+1.1

leaderboard_evidence: T3 public top-10 mean: de_score 68.0, de_direction 74.3, severity 94.9, mmd_u 72.0, variogram 70.7; the decodable leaders are d230 real-cell delay mixtures.

title: Heart: predict the dissected heart as its organ-resident labelled population, not the spatial neighbourhood region
reason: Δproxy +0.83 [+0.73, +0.93] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: For dissected-organ forecast targets, drawing the forecast from the last input's organ-resident annotated population (cardiac + resident non-myocytes) instead of the seed's spatial 25-NN region is CONFIRMED: heart board +1.67 [+1.47, +1.87], Δproxy +0.83 [+0.73, +0.93] (n=8 paired seed pairs, z=15.8), all other boards exactly 0.0. Dev label-proxy evidence (organ_proxy +3.54, e875_organ +9.94, predicted board +3.37) over-predicted the test ~2x, and the realized gain was mostly size metrics (size +1.209 vs distribution +0.329, de_based +0.238, predicted de_score a MISS at +0.3), so treat gains measured on a label-filtered dissection proxy as upper bounds.
mechanism: In heart.py's heart_dissected branch only, the 3000-row forecast is drawn (native coordinates and RNG draw semantics unchanged) from the last input's ORGAN_RESIDENT label mask via an organ_mask(stage) helper, falling back to the seed's 25-NN spatial heart_region when fewer than 500 labelled cells exist, then to the whole input; the non-dissected whole-section branch is untouched (verified byte-identical).
retry_condition: none
method_lessons: Dev label-proxy gains over-predict test transfer roughly 2x: the offline probe promised +3.37 weighted heart (organ_proxy +3.54, e875_organ +9.94, mmd_u/neighborhood_mmd up 6-12 skill points) but the paired test delivered +1.67 with mmd_u +3.2 / neighborhood_mmd +2.3 — discount protocol-approximation evidence when extrapolating to the true test protocol.

Decompose gains by metric kind against the pre-registered metric signature: 3/4 predicted signs hit, but the gain was size-dominated (size +1.209 vs distribution +0.329, de_based +0.238) and de_score was a MISS (+0.3), consistent with the pre-registered risk that the true E12.5 dissection retains luminal blood/macrophage that the dev label-filter drops — the mechanism confirmed, but only partly through the claimed composition channel.

An offline probe retired the planned rival mechanism (row-growth to 25,179 + local jitter) without spending a race: it moved the two dissected splits in opposite directions (+0.55 / -0.47, weighted +0.02), matching w1_c03's 'row growth alone is neutral' and avoiding a bundled, tainted growth constant.

Pre-registered falsifiers ('either dissected split loses, or heart gain below +1.0') made acceptance unambiguous despite the shrinkage, but the severity gate (beta>0 & R^2>0.01) still lists OPEN entries (gata4_1/2, hand2_e825/e925, mef2c_e85) and beta~0.001 with R^2<=0 for mab21l2_e95 / mef2c_e90 — perturbation-magnitude response is an unresolved residual that a composition crop does not touch.

Plan and code critics were disabled by config, so the only independent check was the promotion review (verdict 'promote', no issues, format + finite_nonnegative gates ok) — the known weakness (dev-proxy vs true-dissection mismatch) is exactly the failure mode an enabled design critic should probe.
impl_pitfalls: Labels are read from stage.obs['celltype'] (not 'cell_type'); _match returns None when the column is absent and organ_mask then returns None — without the explicit organ_mask -> 25-NN heart_region -> whole-input fallback chain (MIN_ORGAN=500; the region needs >=100 cardiac cells, 'spatial_3D' in obsm and >=500 kept) a sparsely labelled or small input leaves an empty donor pool instead of degrading gracefully.

The seed's CARDIAC regex deliberately excludes pericardium, so a cardiac-only crop drops organ-surface resident cells; ORGAN_RESIDENT must explicitly add Epicard|Pericard|Proepi|^Peri$ plus resident endothelium (BEC, early-VEC, Intra-Endoth, Great Artery Endoth, Coronary) to match the dissection protocol.

rng.choice(pool.n_obs, n, replace=pool.n_obs < n) silently duplicates cells when the organ-resident pool is smaller than n_cells (default 3000, np.clip to [1000, 25179] from params) — organ pools vary ~7x across stages (E8.5 organ 4,442 cells vs E9.5 31,637), so keep n_cells below the pool size.

Branch isolation is the safety contract: touching the non-dissected TemporalTransport branch or the shared RNG draw semantics would silently move untouched boards — the whole-section heart splits stayed byte-identical (heart_early 48.498 -> 48.498) and embryo/perturbation/temporal deltas were exactly 0.0.

heart_knobs.json is absent, so n_cells must come from context params (default 3000); the mechanism has no tunable numeric parameter, and rows must stay <= 25,179 with native size to pass the format / 3-day plausibility gates (promotion gate: finite_nonnegative + format ok; sanity gene_blowup_frac 0.0, var_ratio 1.03).
claim: For protocol-matched dissected-heart targets, drawing the forecast from the last input's organ-resident cells (cardiac muscle + endocardium/valve/cushion + epicardium/pericardium/proepicardium + intra-organ vascular endothelium) instead of the 25-NN spatial heart region raises the heart board by 2.5-4.5 points on dev, with mmd_u and neighborhood_mmd up 6-12 skill points, variogram and de_score up 1-6, on BOTH dissected dev targets (E9.5 organ_proxy and E8.75 e875_organ); the whole-section splits (heart_early/late/long/e875) are byte-identical. Falsifier: either dissected split loses, or the board gain is below +1.0 heart.
portable: The organ-resident label definition (cardiac + resident non-myocyte classes) could be reused by the temporal board's heart-chamber protocol if it ever needs to emit an organ-resident heart population.

signature.summary: signature 3/4: neighborhood_mmd +ok+2.3, mmd_u +ok+3.2, variogram +ok+1.5, de_score +MISS+0.3

leaderboard_evidence: 77.1 PeacyBlose25 'P3R4_HEART_EXTRAP_E125_CXB_KBULKO30D2XJ15PK1_N25179_R5105' and 73.7 devalex '...CXB_BULKO20...' both crop the heart (CXB) before rescaling; all heart entries above 72 are heart-only real-cell crops.

title: Embryo: per-cell time-interpolated midpoint expression (falsified offline before the race)
reason: the researcher did not change the program
lesson: Per-cell linear-count-space interpolation between two developmental brackets is falsified for embryo expression: averaging unions the brackets' detected genes, inflating population depth from 19.4 to 36.9 genes/cell (truth 17.5) and degrading mmd_u 0.01247->0.03937, variogram 0.00913->0.04897 and neighbourhood MMD 0.07459->0.12397. The offline dev screen killed it before any quick_eval was spent and the parent's depth-thinned 60/40 whole-cell mixture shipped unchanged.
mechanism: Replace the discrete 60/40 whole-cell E6.75/E8.0 mosaic in embryo.py with per-slot linear-count-space blending — profiles = log1p((1-w)*expm1(scaffold) + w*expm1(donor)), one niche-matched, depth-thinned donor per native scaffold slot at the elapsed-time weight w — which was implemented, screened offline with the real dev metric functions, falsified, and reverted (shipped code byte-identical to parent).
retry_condition: Retry per-cell interpolation only with a formulation that preserves the interpolated population detection depth (~17.5 genes/cell), e.g. jointly modelling the two brackets' detection indicators or resampling detections instead of averaging counts; pseudobulk re-weighting toward the later bracket is closed (rank-based de_score cannot move), and a DE retry needs a genuinely better trajectory prior than the bracket difference, not the raw external atlas (de_score -0.03, direction 0.25). Otherwise none.
method_lessons: de_score is rank-based, so any re-weighting of the same two bracket pseudobulks is a DE no-op: the parent's realised change correlates 0.879 with the bracket difference but only 0.392 with dev truth, and the exact time-linear midpoint pseudobulk (de_score 0.241, direction 0.398) is no better than the parent's realised mixture (0.333/0.375) — the DE ceiling is the bracket difference itself.

Donor slot placement is exactly neutral for de_score, mmd_u and variogram (random placement reproduced 0.333/0.375, 0.01207/0.00925) and is the sole driver of neighbourhood MMD (matched 0.0746 vs random 0.1231): judge any placement or matching change only on neighbourhood MMD, and keep the Nystrom matching.

Screening offline with the scorer's real metric functions on the dev split falsified the mechanism for zero quick_eval cost; the 'screen fails -> ship parent unchanged' contract prevented a certain leaderboard loss and preserved the budget.

Micro-refinements of a confirmed mechanism can be mildly negative: matching kernel 128->256 landmarks moved neighbourhood MMD 0.07459->0.07561 and an extra k=5 matching scale to 0.07550 — not worth budget.

No mixture of the two end brackets can create transient intermediate states absent from both (Primitive Streak 5.4% of target vs ~0.6% predicted, Caudal Epiblast 9.4% vs ~1.8%; parent carries 27.0% Unknown vs 12.5% target) — closing that gap needs a depth-preserving expression-level model, not a different mixture.

Aggregate metrics hide localised failure: posterior/streak genes are under-predicted (Tbx6 +0.57 true vs -0.28 pred, Wnt3a +0.39 vs -0.07, Hoxb1 +0.42 vs -0.04), so diagnose per gene/germ layer before planning expression changes.
impl_pitfalls: Linear count-space averaging of two sparse profiles unions their detected genes (depth 19.4->36.9 genes/cell); depth-thinning the donor before blending does not prevent the union — detection must be modelled explicitly, not just expression.
Blending one donor into every scaffold slot leaves no pure single-bracket cells, so the shallow unimodal observation depth achieved by the discrete 60/40 mixture plus depth thinning is unreachable.

Pseudobulk and full-cell evaluations give non-comparable raw de_scores (exact midpoint pseudobulk 0.241 vs parent 0.333 at full-cell evaluation) — always probe under the leaderboard's own evaluation regime before declaring a variant 'no better'.

When a screen fails, restore the workspace byte-identically to the parent (diff-checked) and keep probe scripts in a separate analysis/ directory outside the ws so the shipped submission contains no falsified code.
claim: Replacing the discrete 60/40 mixture of E6.75 and E8.0 whole cells with a per-cell, linear-count-space time interpolation (each native scaffold cell mixed with a niche-matched donor cell at weight = elapsed-time fraction) should keep the population unimodal at the intermediate developmental state and move the dev embryo metrics up: mmd_u and variogram improve (predicted <= -15% raw error each) while de_score, de_direction and native occupancy change by <= 1 point.
leaderboard_evidence: Public P3 embryo: WeiQA 'p3_e775_m369_nystrom_neighborhood_embedding_n5000_v1' 78.8, makabaka 'E7.5 skeleton, midpoint geometry' 76.9, top-10 mean 80.4 (occupancy 100 for every top entry).

title: Heart: emit the dissected organ's own cell population and grow its extent by the inputs' own organ-share trend
reason: Δproxy +0.96 [+0.86, +1.06] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85 | promotion review veto: Test breakage: ws/heart.py:99-110,143,172 - organ_share computes rms_organ/rms_all; on the real test the last input E10.5 is a dissected heart, so rms_all is the organ and the share is ~1.0 (saturated), while the earlier whole-section inputs run 0.71-0.92. The 5-input polyfit slope is therefore driven by the sampling-protocol change, not organ growth, and the code extrapolates an impossible share >1 to grow the E12.5 forecast by ~1.18x; the dev race uses whole-section inputs only and cannot see this.; Misrepre
lesson: Emitting the last input's annotated organ-resident population (cardiac + Peri/BEC/Early-VEC/great-artery/intra-endothelial) instead of a spatial 25-NN heart crop is a repeatable dissected-heart win — heart +1.93 (proxy +0.96 [+0.86,+1.06], z +18.3, n=8; predicted metric signature 3/3; size-metric gain +1.46) — but the bundled input-derived growth term got the change rejected: on the real test the last input E10.5 is itself a dissected heart, so log(rms_organ/rms_all) saturates at ~1.0 (whole-section inputs run 0.71-0.92), the 5-input polyfit slope tracks the sampling-protocol switch rather than organ growth, and the code extrapolates an impossible share >1 to grow the E12.5 forecast ~1.18x — a failure mode structurally invisible in dev, whose inputs are all whole sections.
mechanism: On context['sampling']=='heart_dissected', emit the last input's annotated organ-resident population (CARDIAC | Peri | BEC | Early-VEC | Great Artery Endoth | Intra-Endoth) instead of the seed's spatial 25-NN heart-region crop, and multiply the emitted coordinates about their centroid by a damped (h_eff/(1+0.45 h_eff)), 0.70-nat-capped, >=0-clipped log-linear extrapolation of the inputs' organ share log(rms_organ/rms_all) over the horizon beyond the last input interval.
retry_condition: Resubmit the organ-population emission alone — it is independently CONFIRMED ([w1_c04]: +1.67 heart on a different parent) and carries the entire gain here; a growth term is retryable only if its rate is fit from same-protocol inputs (skip or hard-zero the slope when the last input is dissected and its share is saturated ~1.0, so the polyfit cannot see the protocol step) and the five heart-gene severity OPENs (gata4_1/2, hand2_e825/e925, mef2c_e85) are resolved or shown benign.
method_lessons: A term engineered to be exactly 1.000 on every dev split (flat organ share -> no growth on heart_e875_organ) cannot be validated by the dev race; its whole test-side value (1.18x at E12.5) rested on the public R=510.5 prior, and promotion review rightly treated it as untested behavior.

A derived covariate is confound-free only under the protocol it was derived from: log(rms_organ/rms_all) removes the field-of-view confound for whole-section inputs, but a dissected input makes rms_all==rms_organ and saturates the share at ~1.0, so a fit over mixed-protocol inputs measures the protocol switch, not growth — check every input-derived statistic against the test's actual input configuration.
Never extrapolate a bounded quantity past its bound: share <= 1 was extrapolated >1; the 0.45 damping and 0.70-nat cap bounded magnitude but could not restore validity.

PROMISING statistics do not imply confirmation: despite Δproxy +0.96 (z +18.3, n=8), a 3/3 predicted signature (scale_log_ratio +11.7, neighborhood_mmd +2.3, mmd_u +3.2) and zero deltas on the embryo/temporal/perturbation boards, the severity gate flagged 5 of 7 heart-gene perturbation targets OPEN (gata4_1/2, hand2_e825/e925, mef2c_e85; β 0.21-0.67, R² 0.17-0.41, mag 0.53-1.30) and promotion review vetoed.
Both critics were disabled by config and returned vacuous 'go'/'pass'; the confound was caught only at promotion review — a disabled critic's verdict is no evidence.

Population swaps trade metric kinds asymmetrically: on e875_organ occupancy_dice 49.8->100 and scale_log_ratio 50.1->100 but d2_shape 71.4->30.2 (E8.5 vs E8.75 organ outlines differ, unrecoverable from the inputs); still net +7.48 on that split (quick-eval), so net-board claims must net such trades explicitly.
impl_pitfalls: ws/heart.py:99-110,143,172: organ_share = rms_organ/rms_all has no protocol/saturation guard; when the input itself is a dissected organ, rms_all IS the organ, the share is ~1.0, and the branch silently reads a protocol artifact as growth signal.

The 5-input polyfit mixes sampling protocols across inputs (whole-section 0.71-0.92, final dissected ~1.0), letting the single protocol step dominate the slope and extrapolate share >1 (~1.18x growth applied to the E12.5 forecast).

The byte-identical check enumerated only the heart_* splits (heart_e875 Δ0 verified); heart-gene perturbation splits share the heart_dissected context key and were silently changed too — enumerate affected splits by context key, not by board name.

title: T3: repair the clean-room d230 developmental-delay mixture (all branches return a valid forecast) and re-race it
reason: Δproxy +2.13 [+2.10, +2.17] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.629 R² 0.75 mag 0.76 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Forecasting a broadly acting, non-DNA-binding signalling knockout as the wild type 0.23 d earlier - replacing a seeded, lineage-scaled fraction of rows with real earlier-stage WT cells, gated only on context['external'] GO terms, no fitted amplitude - gains +2.13 proxy points [+2.10,+2.17] n=8 z=102.5 on the perturbation board (Mef2c E8.5 ~68->84, metric signature 5/5, all six gate-0 dev knockouts byte-identical to the parent), the third independent confirmation of the same mechanism (+2.11 twice in w3_c00/w3_c04, +2.13 here). The cycle-level repair was purely operational: the w3_c06 version was rejected only because a zero-draw fallback branch raised TypeError (w_mean passed twice to _diag) instead of returning the parent output - a mechanism can be sound yet fail on one untested branch.
mechanism: Re-shipped the w3_c06 clean-room perturbation_go_delay.py with the duplicate-kwarg zero-draw crash fixed and every branch audited to return a valid forecast: a gene-blind real-cell stage match (w_stage=(t_last-t_target)/interval) plus a GO-gated 0.23 d WT delay with lineage-conditional weights w_l=clip(w_stage+0.23*gate*rank_l/interval, 0, 0.92), hooked between the parent composition forecast and calibrate_response, bypassing the parent's 0.65 calibration on the delay path and returning the parent's calibrated output unchanged on every zero/no-op branch.
retry_condition: none
method_lessons: Attribution by design: the +2.13 was carried by a single split (mef2c_e85 68.17->~84) while every gate-0 knockout (gata4_1/2, hand2_e825/e925, mab21l2_e95, mef2c_e90) stayed byte-identical to the parent with guards 0.00 against the -0.25 floor, so the gain is attributable to the intended branch, not global drift.

A predicted metric signature is a cheap falsifier of 'right score, wrong reason': all five moved as predicted (de_score +2.3, de_direction +3.1, mmd_u +3.5, variogram +2.5, severity_slope +1.1), and the gain split by metric kind (de_based 1.54, distribution 0.54, size 0.0) matches what a stage-delay can and cannot move.

A two-sided GO gate separates the unseen test gene from every dev knockout using only the vetted external channel: DNA-binding TF GO:0003700 (Gata4/Hand2/Mef2c) or narrow support (Mab21l2: 1 term, 4 partners) forces gate 0, while Ctnnb1 (112 terms, GO:0007165/7154, 279 partners, no GO:0003700) gets gate 1.0.

The delay realises the earlier stage's expression state rather than a synthetic response: the residual under-predicted genes are the contractile program (Myl7 -2.15, Myl4 -1.94, Ttn -2.05), and real-cell stage displacement supplies the amplitude, so no fitted response constant is needed on the delay path.

When the knocked-out gene is masked or off-panel, the pathway's measured per-lineage detection rank is the only rule-compliant locality proxy; scaling the delay by rank_l keeps narrow genes at zero delay.

Severity-gate openness on genes whose output is byte-identical to the parent (gata4_1 beta 0.333 R^2 0.17, hand2_e825 beta 0.668 R^2 0.18) describes the parent, not the change - do not credit the intervention for it.
impl_pitfalls: perturbation_go_delay.py:210 passed w_mean twice to _diag, so the zero-draw fallback raised TypeError instead of returning the parent output; audit every _diag call site for duplicate keyword arguments - one crashing branch rejected an otherwise +2.13 change.
Sourcing the gate from context['expression_prior'] (w3_c00/w3_c04) violates rule provenance and gets the run rejected despite +2.11 x2; only context['external'] GO terms are admissible.

The dev race only exercises the gene-blind stage match - the d230 branch is dev-invisible by construction, so keep a synthetic off-panel Ctnnb1 simulation (gate 1.0, 5149/7449 rows replaced, harness.check passes) as the evidence for the invisible branch.

Hook placement is contractual: between the parent composition forecast and calibrate_response, the delay path returns before the 0.65 calibration runs, and every zero/no-op/fallback branch returns the parent's calibrated output unchanged (the only change on that path is a conditional return).

title: Embryo: constant-cell-density size law and time-proportional midpoint mixture, with the bracket-mirror weight fixed
reason: Δproxy +1.08 [+1.01, +1.16] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: On embryo-stage interpolation, deriving size from the embryo's own constant-packing-density law (rms = rms_scaffold*(n_interp/n_scaffold)^(1/3)) instead of log-linear radius interpolation fixed scale_log_ratio 40.75 -> ~100 (log-radius error +0.246 -> +0.005), and stacked with a time-proportional, scaffold-mirrored transplant weight (STATE_WARP 0.7 -> 1.0) gained +2.16 embryo board points (delta-proxy +1.08 [+1.01, +1.16], z +27.3, n=8). DE metrics cannot move by this route: de_score/de_direction are invariant under per-gene monotone transforms of delta-p, so mixture weights and DE-gene pseudobulk rescaling leave the DE ranking untouched (de_based gain only 0.187 vs size 4.849).
mechanism: In ws/embryo.py only: replaced log-linear rms-radius interpolation with the constant-density cube-root law rms = radii[k_scaffold]*(n_interp/counts[k_scaffold])**(1/3) where n_interp is the log-linear interpolation of the inputs' n_obs, and set the transplanted-cell weight to the elapsed-time fraction (STATE_WARP 0.7 -> 1.0) with donor_frac mirrored from the scaffold side (fraction if k_scaffold==0 else 1-fraction), the same donor_frac driving depth thinning.
retry_condition: none
method_lessons: CONFIRMED by a paired 8-seed race (delta-proxy +1.08 [+1.01, +1.16], z +27.3, n=8); the single-seed quick screen (59.57, byte-matching w2_c05's published screen) is not the estimate - the race is.

de_score and de_direction are invariant under any per-gene monotone (positive-scaling) transform of delta-p, and a two-bracket real-cell mixture has delta-p proportional to donor_frac*(P_late - P_early), so no mixture weight or DE-gene pseudobulk blend can change the DE ranking; moving DE needs new gene-level information (transient/peak genes that reverse between brackets: Tbx6, Msx2, Wnt3a, Cer1, Hand1), and the external atlas cannot supply it here because its E7.25 bracket coincides with the dev target (dev-only label proxy).

A mirror fix that is a no-op on the evaluation paths (dev fraction 0.4 and test fraction 0.5 both put the earlier bracket as scaffold) resolves a prior veto (w2_c05) while preserving the paired +1.91 gain exactly and making the law correct for targets past the midpoint.

Predictable invariants aid attribution: d2_shape and occupancy_dice depend only on canonicalised positions, so a uniform radius rescale leaves them byte-identical; observed signature (scale +58.2, variogram +8.3, mmd_u +1.8, occupancy +0.0) matched the predicted 4/6, with the two misses (neighborhood_mmd +0.6, de_score +0.5) still non-negative.
Exhausted retries, do not revisit without new information: Nystrom neighbourhood matching (w2_c00 nil, w2_c04 -2.83), stretching (test occupancy gate), convex depth thinning (w2_c03 -8.4).
Embryo size/state laws do not move knockout severity: perturbation board delta 0.0 and severity gates (beta>0 & R^2>0.01) stayed OPEN for gata4_1/2, hand2_e825/e925 and mef2c_e85.
impl_pitfalls: Bracket-mirror asymmetry: w2_c05 was vetoed because the donor weight was not mirrored when the later bracket is the scaffold (embryo.py:199); compute donor_frac once (fraction if k_scaffold==0 else 1-fraction) and pass the same value to both the transplant count and thin_transplants.

The E8.0 imaging field is 62% less dense (density 10.32 vs 6.2-6.4 for E6.75/E7.25); log-linear radius interpolation inherits this artefact and overshoots true intermediate radii by 21-25% - derive size from each stage's own n_obs, not from interpolating radii across heterogeneous imaging fields.

Hidden exponent knobs like STATE_WARP 0.7 encode an unjustified tempo warp; the time-proportional midpoint (weight = donor_frac) is what the public recipes describe and what w2_c00 confirmed (+2.56 board).

portable: The constant-packing-density radius law (rms proportional to n_cells^(1/3) from the nearer input's own density) is a stage-agnostic alternative to log-linear radius interpolation for any T2 board whose later input is imaged with a wider field than its cell number implies.

title: Heart: input-derived bounded organ expansion (organ/field RMS-share rate) applied only beyond the observed interval
reason: Δproxy +0.55 [+0.55, +0.55] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85 | promotion review veto: Misrepresentation: ws/heart.py:192 - The applied multiplier includes an uncapped pool-to-sample RMS correction. Five-input checks with the test timing and sampling flag produced 4.15x expansion and 0.79x shrinkage despite the claimed 1.57x expansion cap.; Misrepresentation: ws/heart.py:115 - An unusable intermediate stage discards the previous usable measurement, so two valid stages separated by a missing label set yield no growth despite a positive measured slope.
lesson: Input-derived organ/field RMS-share extrapolation beyond the last observed interval moved the heart board exactly as predicted (scale_log_ratio skill 41.5->94.8, heart +1.1, dproxy +0.55 [n=8, z=724], size-only gain +1.107 with distribution/de_based 0.0, predicted signature 4/4), yet was rejected for misrepresentation rather than mechanism failure: the actually applied factor included an uncapped pool-to-sample RMS correction (4.15x expansion and 0.79x shrinkage in five-input checks vs the claimed 1.57x cap), and an unusable intermediate stage discarded the last usable measurement so valid bracketing stages yielded no growth.
mechanism: After dissected-branch sampling, isotropically rescale the drawn heart cloud's coordinates by f = exp(min(0.45, r*h)), where r is the max positive log-slope of the organ-RMS/section-RMS share (plus an absolute organ-RMS fallback) across input stages and h = target_time - times[-1], applied only when h > last observed interval.
retry_condition: Retry the same share-rate mechanism with the cap enforced on the total applied factor (n_scale, including any pool-to-sample RMS correction) and with stage iteration that retains the last usable measurement across label-missing stages; validate under the production configuration (five inputs, test timing, heart_dissected sampling flag) before claiming the cap, since 2-input dev splits never exercised the violating path.
method_lessons: Normalize organ size by whole-section RMS before estimating growth: raw organ RMS was non-monotone across inputs (250.7 -> 193.7 -> 192.6 -> 307.4, section-coverage changes) while the share was monotone (0.707 -> 0.759 -> 0.887 -> 0.918); the literal raw-RMS plan would have been a no-op, so the implementer's declared deviation to the share was sound.

Gate extrapolation strictly on h > last observed interval: within-interval targets are interpolations the last-stage copy already matches, which kept heart_e875_organ byte-identical (79.10 unchanged) and all non-dissected splits at 0.

A matched 4/4 metric signature and a tight paired gain (dproxy +0.55 [+0.55, +0.55], z 724) confirm the dev-level effect, not the code's claims: the promotion review reproduced the five-input test condition and found the declared 1.57x cap bound only the growth-rate component of a compound multiplier.

Statistical significance does not override implementation honesty: significance gates (dproxy, severity gate) and the promotion review veto are independent, and the candidate was rejected despite z = 724 and a fully OPEN severity gate.
impl_pitfalls: ws/heart.py:192 - the applied multiplier is target_rms / r_out, where target_rms uses the last input's full organ-pool RMS but r_out is the drawn n-cell sample's RMS; this pool-to-sample correction is uncapped, so the real factor reached 4.15x (and 0.79x shrinkage) instead of the declared 1.57x cap. Cap the final applied factor, not one component of it.

ws/heart.py:113-116 - an unusable stage (_organ_and_field_rms returning None, e.g. missing celltype labels) resets prev to None, discarding the previous usable measurement; two usable stages separated by one unusable stage contribute no rate even with a positive measured slope.

Dev quick-eval used 2 input stages and never hit the violating path; the misrepresentation only surfaced in five-input checks under the test timing and sampling flag - smoke-test claimed invariants under the production input count before declaring them.

title: Embryo: close the capture-depth gap of the native scaffold cells by local-field depth completion up to the mixture's own expected depth
reason: the researcher did not change the program
lesson: Local-field depth completion — filling each native scaffold cell's undetected genes from its 32-NN pseudobulk up to the mixture's expected depth (cap 18.48 vs truth 16.71 detected genes/cell) — was implemented, measured at the seed-101 quick eval as a board loss (59.57 -> 57.93; mmd_u -8.27, variogram -6.93, de_score +2.62, neighborhood_mmd +3.24), and reverted byte-identically to parent: mean-filling is partial mean-tiling that strips the cell-to-cell variance the distribution metrics reward, so the transplant mixture's bimodal depth (60% rows at 13.74, 40% thinned donors at 25.6) is information, not a defect. The cycle also falsified offline the external Extended Mouse Atlas as a DE source (truth-delta Spearman +0.31 vs the released mixture's +0.41; top/bottom-8 DE overlap 0.25 vs 0.38; flat where truth moves: Nkx1-2 +0.01 vs +1.32, Twist1 +0.03 vs +0.90, Aldh1a2 +0.01 vs +0.57); the shipped program is unchanged, evidence class SKIPPED.
mechanism: Tested then reverted (embryo.py shipped byte-identical to parent w2_c08, md5 verified): for native non-transplant rows only, undetected genes were filled with the 32-NN local-field pseudobulk mean in decreasing-field order until the row reached the mixture's expected-depth cap (1-w)*scaffold_depth + w*thinned_donor_depth, gated by one DEPTH_COMPLETE constant; geometry, radius law, weight and thinning untouched.
retry_condition: none for the mean-fill variant — every preregistered distribution falsifier fired at the screen; a retry is justified only with a variance-preserving fill (per-gene draws from the 32-NN conditional count distribution, not the neighbourhood mean) AND a bracket where the emitted depth is genuinely below the target's (here the cap 18.48 sat above truth 16.71, so completion overshot by construction); the atlas needs a panel/protocol-matched external source before any DE-prior retry.
method_lessons: Filling missing detections with the neighbourhood mean is partial mean-tiling: it deletes exactly the cell-to-cell variance that variogram and RBF-MMD reward; the -8.27 mmd_u / -6.93 variogram cost was ~2x the +2.62 de_score / +3.24 neighborhood_mmd gain, and the board weighting (mmd_u 15% + variogram 10% vs de 25% split over two terms) makes that trade unpayable.

A mechanism passing its own local screen (neighborhood_mmd +3.24, de_score +2.62) can still lose the board: preregistered falsifiers on the distribution metrics are what caught it — keep them on mmd_u/variogram, not on the mechanism's target metric.

Bimodal detection depth in a transplant mixture is not a defect to smooth away: shallow native rows (13.74 genes/cell) carry real single-cell information the distribution metrics prefer over a depth-homogenized cloud.

title: Embryo: damp the high-depth tail of transplanted cells with conditional molecule thinning

lesson: Halving the expected above-target detection depth of transplanted donor cells compressed the embryo depth tail exactly as designed (90th-pct 15-neighbour depth 30.41→27.60, mean cell depth 19.40→18.51 vs target 17.51) yet clearly hurt skill: paired Δproxy −0.29 (z −4.3; all 3 seed-pair diffs negative), embryo board −0.57, with neighborhood_mmd −1.26, expression MMD −1.36 and DE recovery −1.22 breaching the 1-point guards while only variogram improved (+0.77). title: Heart: anchor the native crop to annotated organ size and forecast bounded constant-density growth

method_lessons: The preregistered metric signature was a sharp mechanism check: 5/5 matched (scale_log_ratio up; d2_shape, occupancy_dice, neighborhood_mmd, de_score unchanged) and gain-by-metric-kind shows the entire +1.248 came from size, confirming the gain came from the intended pathway with no collateral drift.

title: Embryo: time-proportional (elapsed-fraction) state mixture on the diverse parent, with the bracket-mirror weight fixed and constant-packing-density size

lesson: On the diverse embryo parent, measuring the state-mixture weight from the scaffold side (w = donor_frac, exponent 1.0, mirrored when the later bracket is the scaffold) plus a constant-packing-density radius law (rms = rms_scaffold*(n_interp/n_scaffold)**(1/3)) raised the embryo board +2.48 (Δproxy +1.24 [+1.19,+1.30], z=42.2, n=8), with size +4.85, variogram +11.0, mmd_u +2.6, de_direction +1.3; de_score stalled at +0.6 because the sign-reversal of gastrulation-midpoint genes (Hand1/Tbx6/Msx2/Wnt3a) is invariant under any mixture-weight scaling.
mechanism: On the depth-thinned diverse parent (w2_c02), replaced the tempo warp (w = f**0.7, weight inverted past the midpoint) with the elapsed-time donor fraction measured from the scaffold side (w = donor_frac, exponent 1.0, mirrored when the later bracket is the scaffold) and replaced log-linear radius interpolation with constant-packing-density scaling rms = rms_scaffold*(n_interp/n_scaffold)**(1/3).
retry_condition: none
method_lessons: de_score/de_direction are invariant under per-gene positive scaling of delta-p (delta-p ∝ donor_frac*(P_late − P_early)), so no mixture-weight exponent can fix DE; DE gains require changing which cells enter the mixture, not the weight — confirmed by the endpoint difference reversing for genes that peak at the gastrulation midpoint (Hand1 truth +0.72 vs pred −0.15; Tbx6 +0.57 vs −0.46).

Check packing density across bracket stages before choosing a radius law: density is constant to 2.7% within the dev interval (rms/n^(1/3) = 6.39 at E6.75, 6.22 at E7.25) but the E8.0 bracket is 62% less dense (10.32), so log-linear radius interpolation through the discontinuity overshoots +0.246 log while the density law lands +0.017 (rms 149.8 vs truth 147.29).

An n=8 paired repeated race was decisive (se 0.029, z=42.2): the mirrored-weight + density-radius effect is enormous relative to seed noise, and the embryo-only change left heart/perturbation/temporal exactly 0.0, confirming no cross-board leakage.
impl_pitfalls: Mirror-direction bug: when the later bracket is the scaffold (f>0.5), giving the elapsed-time weight to the earlier bracket emits 82% earlier-bracket profiles at fraction 0.75 instead of 25%; the weight must be read from the scaffold side, and at the exact 0.5 tie the code silently takes the earlier scaffold, making the mirror fix a numerical no-op at the test fraction.

Log-linear radius interpolation inherits the E8.0 bracket's low packing density and overshoots the dev radius +0.246 log; derive radius from the scaffold's own density (rms ∝ n^(1/3)) whenever brackets straddle a density regime change (the two laws coincide on the E7.5/E8.0 test interval, so the change is neutral-to-positive on test, not dev-only).

A uniform isotropic radius rescale leaves d2_shape, occupancy_dice and native_occupancy byte-identical; occupancy gains need a non-uniform spatial mechanism, and the seed's PCA stretch (which scored occupancy 2.8 on test) has been removed.
The 5000-row cap is already the board maximum (interpolated dev count ~10000), so no cell-count lever remains on the embryo board.
