title: Temporal: fleet-tune bounded real-donor maturity and cushion doses
reason: no effect: every dev split scores exactly as the parent | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Exposing maturity_mass/ot_strength/cushion_fill knobs whose defaults exactly replicate the parent, then leaving all selection to fleet tuning, was a bit-for-bit no-op: the fleet-selected settings reproduced the parent, all 3 paired seed diffs were exactly 0.0 (Δproxy +0.00, CI [0,0]) and every board matched the parent — despite verified knob-to-draw sensitivity and an endpoint dose check that only trades within-lineage displacement recovery (endocardial 4.1%->7.1% of observed change, other cardiac 1.6%->2.4%) against worse myocardium (2.8%->2.5%) and coarse composition TV (0.199->0.202). Aggregate dev skill has no direction to reward on these dose axes.
mechanism: Declared temporal_knobs.json (maturity_mass 0.25-0.75, ot_strength 0.35-0.65, cushion_fill 0.25-0.50, default 0.5 = parent) and piped the values from context params into the existing Gaussian maturity mixture, its time-scaled OT displacement step (capped at 1.5 intervals), and the capped mass-conserving cushion transfer, with all score-based parameter selection left to fleet tuning.
retry_condition: Only if the selection signal changes: a tuning objective or dev split that rewards what the doses move (mmd_u/variogram or within-lineage pseudobulk displacement, or a split with a different target stage / non-saturated longer horizon), plus a local non-default positive control that beats the parent before spending a fleet race.
method_lessons: Exact-zero paired diffs (se=0, CI [0,0] on all 3 seed pairs) mean the raced configuration is behaviorally identical to the parent; classify 'tuner kept defaults' as a no-op deployment, not a measured null, and verify pre-race that tuning actually visits non-default points.

When the entire change is 'expose knobs and let the fleet tune', the hypothesis lives or dies on the tuner; identical parent/candidate quick scores (50.67 vs 50.67) already showed the aggregate objective is insensitive at these knobs and foreshadowed the null.

quick_eval.py reports only aggregate skill, so the preregistered mmd_u (+0.4..1.5) and variogram (+0.3..1.5) sub-claims were untestable locally; do not preregister metric-level claims the local harness cannot measure.

The unscored endpoint diagnostic explains the null: raising both Gaussian doses improves endocardial/other-cardiac displacement recovery (4.1%->7.1%, 1.6%->2.4%) but worsens myocardium (2.8%->2.5%) and composition TV (0.199->0.202), so a scalar aggregate objective has no direction to reward.
With plan and code critics disabled by config, no review challenged the no-op risk; a live critic should require a non-default positive control for tuning-only changes.

The severity-gate OPEN flags in the outcome (e.g. hand2_e825 beta 0.668 R2 0.18, mef2c_e85 beta 0.31 R2 0.41) are parent-inherited standing state, not effects of this change, since every split scored exactly as the parent.
impl_pitfalls: diagnose.py has no temporal report; dose sensitivity had to come from the ad-hoc released-stage diagnostic (analysis/released_diagnostic.py) and is unscored.

Three-input two-day and three-day chamber forecasts came out identical because the horizon terms saturate (min(relative_horizon,1.5) OT cap and min(...,1) cushion cap bind), so multi-day outputs cannot discriminate settings.
The plausibility validator had to preselect the same 3,000 highest-variance genes as the check to keep the panel comparable across settings.
The synthetic cushion-cap stress test required widening a rate limit in the analysis script.

Default-equivalence is fragile: both implicit and explicit params must reproduce the parent's CSR storage and metadata; this was checked on val, chamber dev, three-input export and the single-input fallback.
claim: A shared setting for Gaussian maturity mass, Gaussian OT step strength and cushion fill improves the current T1 sampler by +0.2 to +0.8 board points in the eight-pair dev race. Relative to the default parent, mean mmd_u skill should rise by about +0.4 to +1.5 points and mean variogram skill by +0.3 to +1.5 across temporal_val and temporal_heartonly. The claim fails if reseeding retains the defaults, the paired board gain is below +0.2 or its 95% interval includes zero, either distribution metric is flat or worse, or either split loses more than 0.3 board points. A mean de_score or de_direction loss greater than 1.0 skill point or failure of the three-day plausibility or blood gate also rejects the setting.
leaderboard_evidence: devmatrix3607 P3MIX_T1_E12p5_D50_OT50U_CB_XF (84.25; mmd_u 87.51, variogram 85.41), and the 81.70 two-skeleton real-cell maturity selection recipe. The w0_c02 unbalanced OT replication already ran. This cycle tunes the Gaussian OT implementation present in the parent.

title: T3: GO-module-scoped developmental-direction term on the accepted d230 delay parent
reason: the researcher did not change the program
lesson: Negative/skip: nothing shipped and no board movement (paired test SKIPPED, Δproxy +0.00, z +0.0, per-board deltas {}) — the GO-module-axis direction term was implemented, measured on one split, then reverted, because on the mef2c_e90 quick-eval it lost 0.32 split points vs parent (score 56.62→56.30, de_score 53.12→52.04, de_direction flat 53.36→53.35, severity/mmd_u/variogram all slightly worse). The offline module-cosine screen (positive on 5/7 splits, +0.15 to +0.84) did not transfer to the realised parent response, which already carries a composition Delta-p the WT-copy screen did not model.
mechanism: Implemented-then-reverted (net program change: none) helper perturbation_module_axis.py: on panel genes sharing a vetted 5–500-gene GO term with context['knockout'] (≥8 panel genes / ≥8 shared symbols, else byte-identical parent pass-through), apply a zero-preserving multiplicative gain x→x·clip(1+d/mean, 0.5, 2.0) with d = 0.15×(0.23 d/interval)×(WT earlier−latest pseudobulk contrast) clipped to ±0.25, hooked right after prior_comp.predict and before go_delay.mix + calibrate_response.
retry_condition: Retry only as a raced sign×dose grid (flipped sign, or SHIFT_FRAC well below 0.15) on ≥2 splits (mef2c_e90, gata4_1) with fresh quick-eval budget (this cycle's was exhausted at 3 runs), and only after re-screening module-axis alignment against the parent's realised forecast rather than a WT-copy base; the +0.15 positive-sign configuration is falsified on mef2c_e90 and must not be re-run unchanged.
method_lessons: Offline screens must be validated against the realised parent forecast, not a simplified WT-copy base: the module-cosine screen was positive on 5/7 splits yet the dosed term lost de_score (−1.08) on the only measured split, because the parent already carries a composition Delta-p the screen did not model.

A positive screen alignment fixes neither the sign nor the dose of the deployed term — flipped-sign and smaller-dose variants remain open and must be raced, not assumed; one falsified configuration does not falsify the family.

de_score/de_direction depend only on the ranking of Delta-p, so the inherited global-scalar amplitude calibration (response norm held at 0.65× the WT interval) cannot mask a ranking-level effect — the measured de_score drop is a genuine ranking regression, not a renormalisation artefact.

Guard design worked as specified: the ≥8-panel-gene module floor made Mab21l2 (3-gene module) abstain, protecting the accepted narrow-arm path and its weight-2 split, while the ±0.25 shift clip and gain factor ∈[0.5, 2.0] bounded the measured damage to −0.32 split points on the treated split.

Falsify alternative families offline before spending quick-eval: lineage-scoped rollback was killed at zero eval cost by flat cross-lineage state-distance (Mef2c ranks 0.65–1.00, Gata4 0.33–1.00); with only 3 quick-eval runs per cycle, order races by information value.

The cycle ran with a substitute researcher (deepseek-v4.1-flash for the intended claude-opus-5-5) and both critic reviews were null, so the family is only partially tested — treat the un-raced sign/dose variants and the 6 unmeasured splits as open, not refuted.
impl_pitfalls: GO-module support varies wildly per knockout: Mab21l2's module is 3 panel genes, below the ≥8-gene floor, so the helper silently abstains and that weight-2 split is untouched — always check per-knockout module size before expecting an effect.

Lineage-scoped composition rollback has almost no locus to act on for broad modules (state-distance nearly flat across lineages: Mef2c 0.65–1.00, Gata4 0.33–1.00) — verify a per-lineage locus exists before implementing that family.

Hook-order contract: the gain must sit after prior_comp.predict and before go_delay.mix + calibrate_response so the inherited 0.65-interval amplitude anchor renormalises the total response; mis-ordering double-doses the response.

Zero handling: the gain x→x·clip(1+d/mean, 0.5, 2.0) must preserve zeros and skip genes with zero measured WT contrast ('no sign, no change'), every abstain branch must return the parent forecast byte-identically, and the helper must stay RNG-free so the fixed-seed quick-eval remains exactly repeatable (identical numbers on a repeat run).

Pipeline contract quirk: reverting a tested change makes the paired evidence test record SKIPPED ('the researcher did not change the program', Δproxy +0.00, empty per-board deltas), so the negative quick-eval numbers survive only if written into CHANGES.md.
claim: Adding one gene-agnostic direction term -- on the panel genes that share a vetted GO term with the knocked-out gene, shift the predicted pseudobulk by SHIFT_FRAC x (0.23 d / observed interval) x the measured WT earlier-minus-latest contrast -- raises de_score and de_direction on the T3 splits where the knockout's own module moves along the WT developmental axis (predicted: hand2_e925, mef2c_e90, gata4_1/2 up; mab21l2 unchanged because its 3-gene module is below the 8-gene support floor) by +1 to +3 board points, with severity unchanged (the inherited 0.65-interval amplitude calibration renormalises the total response because it is a global scalar gain) and no gene losing more than 0.25 mean points.
leaderboard_evidence: Public P3 T3 top-10 names: 't3-x3-d230' 78.3, 't3-r2-d230' 75.6, 'WT delay composite, Gata4-derived response direction on both...' 73.4 -- the strongest decodable recipes combine a sizeable WT developmental delay with a pathway-level response direction, and their DE/direction terms (67-78) are what separate them from our 60.3/62.9.

title: Embryo midpoint pseudobulk correction on detected genes
reason: Δproxy +0.38 [+0.32, +0.44] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Depth-calibrated bracket-midpoint pseudobulk correction on detected entries is CONFIRMED: Δproxy +0.38 [+0.32, +0.44] over n=8 paired seed runs (z +11.7), embryo board +0.75 [0.63, 0.87] with heart/perturbation/temporal exactly 0.0 (seed-101 embryo_early: DE recovery +2.50, DE direction +0.75, expression MMD +1.70, occupancy unchanged; gains split as distribution 0.585 / de_based 0.102 by metric kind).
mechanism: After donor placement and capture thinning, embryo.py normalizes each bracket's per-gene mean and SE by that bracket's total mean log expression, interpolates the shares at the elapsed fraction onto the prediction's total log scale, and applies the residual as a bounded multiplicative log gain (divided by predicted detection fraction, capped at log(2), tapered by 4*f*(1-f)) only to positively detected entries of genes whose normalized bracket contrast exceeds twice the combined SE.
retry_condition: none
method_lessons: Decomposing the bracket contrast into capture-depth vs gene-profile components (equalizing each bracket's total log expression before blending) is the active ingredient: full-panel rank correlation of mean-log changes rose 0.3506→0.3799 (dev) / 0.351→0.384 (diagnostic) and pseudobulk MAE fell 0.0847→0.0816.

A single diagnostic subsample can contradict the fleet: raw de_score fell 0.187→0.156 on the audit subsample while the paired 8-seed race confirmed +0.38 proxy with z +11.7 — acceptance must rest on repeated paired seed comparisons, not one sample.

The predicted metric signature was only 3/5, and both misses (mmd_u = predicted vs +1.7 actual, neighborhood_mmd = predicted vs +0.6 actual) broke guards in the favorable direction: any edit that changes expression mass moves distribution metrics even when detection masks and coordinates are identical, so '=' guard predictions are unreliable for expression-mass corrections.

An endpoint-midpoint prior fixes direction on strongly-residual genes (83% agreement with the released target for the 30 genes with |midpoint residual| > 0.1; H19 moved from +0.13 to −0.17 vs observed −0.81) but cannot manufacture transient peaks — several transient increases stayed underpredicted.

The per-gene severity gate shows the gain is gene-subset driven (OPEN at gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17, hand2_e825 β 0.668 mag 1.30, mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41; β≈0.001 at mab21l2_e95 and mef2c_e90), so report per-gene attribution, not just aggregate skill.

Both critics were disabled by config ('go'/'pass' with no substantive review), so preregistered dose, endpoint-exact contract checks, and the paired fleet race carried all validation weight this cycle; the confirmed status has no independent reviewer signal behind it.
impl_pitfalls: The pseudobulk residual must be divided by the predicted detection fraction and applied only to positive entries; touching zero entries would destroy the parent's spatial detection pattern that guards and occupancy metrics compare.

The dose cap and 4*f*(1-f) taper are what make both bracket endpoints reproduce the parent's expression exactly — required for the coordinate/detection-mask equality contract (5,000 distinct positions, shared panel, finite nonnegative expression, endpoint expression bit-identical).

A gene-specific gain applied on the parent's normalized scale shifts per-cell expression row-mass (median ratio 1.013, 5th–95th percentile 0.811–1.388) even with identical detections (native-occupancy ratio 0.9760), so distribution guards can trip despite unchanged occupancy.

The true test midpoint is unseen, so the local audit had to substitute released E7.25/E8.0 brackets and exercise the mirrored scaffold plus both endpoints to validate contract behavior ahead of the harness's real export gate.

Inheritance is load-bearing: only embryo.py changed, and the tuned state warp (1.12), coordinate draws, donor assignment and zero entries had to be kept from the parent verbatim for paired-contract equality.
claim: On embryo_early, a bounded expression shift toward the depth-calibrated endpoint midpoint will improve paired de_score by 0.5–2.0 skill points and de_direction by 0.7–1.8. Native occupancy must be identical, and mmd_u and neighborhood_mmd must each lose at most 0.5 skill points. A failure of either DE minimum or any guard refutes the claimed useful improvement. Expect at least a 0.005 increase in full-population Spearman correlation of mean-log changes against the released dev target.

retry_condition: The gain is real and deterministic (+0.31 proxy over 8 seed pairs, heart +0.62, size-metric gain +0.629), so a retry is justified once the contract is fixed: either guard ws/heart.py:141 so the organ-to-crop radius ratio is inert when log growth clips to zero, or rewrite the hypothesis to disclose that term as coordinate-moving; the five OPEN severity-gate splits (gata4_1/2, hand2_e825/e925, mef2c_e85 with β>0 & R²>0.01 despite a 0.0 perturbation board delta) also need explicit disposition as screens rather than confirmed regressions.
method_lessons: An isotropic transform about the emitted centroid is a clean single-metric lever: every non-size metric stayed byte-identical, confirming the predicted 5/5 metric signature with scale_log_ratio 41.5→71.63 as the only mover.

Byte-identical metrics on a dev split do not prove a promised invariance holds in general: heart_e875_organ was unchanged only because its organ-frame ratio happened to be ≈1.0, which masked the contract violation until the promotion review; the decisive rejection was the misrepresentation veto, not the gain.

The scorer matches cell counts before comparing shape metrics (common/shape_metrics._match_n) and subsamples MMD/variogram/neighbourhood to 1500–2000 cells, so emitted row count (the public N25179 separation) is a selection artifact, not a testable lever.

Public-recipe constants unreadable at prediction time must be replaced by input-derived analogues: the target RMS 510.5 became cube-root count growth, validated offline first (E8.75→E9.5 organ RMS ratio 1.614 vs cube-root count ratio 1.687, supporting constant packing density).

Hold the two-target rule when porting optional components: the anisotropy rescale improved the E9.5 organ split offline (d2 0.0216→0.0183, occupancy 0.695→0.745) but lost on E8.75 (d2 0.0654→0.0742, occupancy 0.588→0.558) and was correctly not shipped.

Zero per-board delta does not clear the severity gate: five perturbation splits stayed OPEN (β>0 & R²>0.01) with perturbation delta 0.0, so gate flags are correlation screens that need explicit disposition before promotion.
impl_pitfalls: ws/heart.py:141: the size law is a product of two terms; when the log-growth term clips to zero (contracting organ counts or unusable priors) the organ-to-crop radius ratio still expands the output, breaking the promised unchanged-coordinates contract — caught only by promotion review, not by quick-eval.

The checked dev split masked the bug because its composite factor landed at ≈1.0; a coincidental ≈1.0 factor on the split you test is not evidence the degenerate path is inert — force growth=0 explicitly.
Porting the public row count (N25179) would only risk duplicate donors: the scorer matches counts for every shape metric and subsamples the distribution metrics.

Full-horizon extrapolation of a per-interval growth rate deviates from the accepted w1_c07 one-interval pattern (×1.486 vs ×1.141 on dev) and is only safe with the explicit 0.45 log cap; the grow-only clip to 1.0 on negative count intervals must be verified per split (heart_e875_organ clips to the organ-frame ratio ≈1.0).

title: T3: Transfer the single-normalized GO-weighted d230 delay to the diverse parent
reason: Δproxy +3.78 [+3.21, +4.35] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.111 R² 0.09 mag 0.24 OPEN; mef2c_e85 β 0.629 R² 0.75 mag 0.76 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Porting the accepted single-normalized GO-weighted d230 delay onto the diverse seed parent is CONFIRMED: +3.78 paired perturbation points [+3.21, +4.35] (z 12.5, n=8) with the predicted metric signature 5/5 (de_score +2.6, de_direction +3.9, severity_slope +2.3, mmd_u +2.7, variogram +2.8) and no board regressions. Most of the gain came from elapsed-time stage matching alone (Mef2c E8.5: 6,835/7,449 rows replaced, +16.43 split points, severity R² 0.41→0.75), while the narrow GO-module path needed only 812/7,449 rows at mean probability 0.114 to open Mab21l2's closed severity fit (β 0.111, R² 0.09).
mechanism: Into the diverse parent's perturbation forecast (before calibration), a seeded subset of incumbent latest-WT rows is replaced with real cells from the preceding WT input at probability = elapsed-time stage weight + GO-gated delay (0.23 d narrow module or WT GO-breadth-scaled systemic) ÷ WT interval × lineage WT module detection ÷ peak lineage mean (normalized once), clipped to [0, 0.92].
retry_condition: none
method_lessons: Single-seed dev splits underestimated the effect: seed-101 implied ~+2.42, below the preregistered +3.0 fail bar, yet the 8-seed paired race confirmed +3.78 — gate acceptance on the multi-seed paired statistic, never on a one-seed dev extrapolation.

A preregistered metric signature that lands 5/5 (de_score, de_direction, severity_slope, mmd_u, variogram all moved as predicted) is strong evidence the mechanism acted as intended and separates mechanistic gain from noise.

Small targeted replacement fractions can open closed fits: replacing 812/7,449 Mab21l2 rows at mean probability 0.114 opened its full-population severity (β 0.111, R² −0.034→0.09) and lifted DE direction 0.219→0.341.
Subsampled quick-eval metrics can move opposite to full-population fits (Mab21l2 quick severity −1.02 while full-pop R² rose); do not gate on the subsampled severity.

A normalization bug can masquerade as mechanism failure: w3_c08's +4.46 was vetoed only for dividing lineage weights by the peak twice and therefore did not estimate the single-normalized dose re-tested here — always re-run a vetoed mechanism after fixing the confound before concluding the mechanism itself fails.

Composition cost is split-dependent: Mab21l2 composition TV rose 0.120→0.131 while distribution metrics improved, and Mef2c E8.5 TV fell 0.283→0.175 — expect earlier-pool composition mismatch to cost TV on some splits without invalidating the gain.

With plan and code critics disabled by config, verification fell to preregistration plus release-configuration checks; the exact-match Ctnnb1 reproduction of w3_c07 on released WT inputs (7,449 rows, 500 genes, weight 0.692729, 5,135 earlier rows) is the pattern to keep when porting accepted mechanisms.
impl_pitfalls: Normalize the lineage WT-module detection by the peak lineage mean exactly once; dividing twice silently double-scales the dose (the w3_c08 veto cause).
Removing AnnData layers can clobber the primary X matrix — preserve it explicitly, and guard missing earlier coordinates before mixing.

Run the mixer before the incumbent expression calibration; never apply the fitted calibration to a realized mixture (it supplies its own response amplitude) and fall back to the parent's calibrated path only when the draw makes no replacements.
Add the delay term to the unclipped elapsed-time weight before clipping the final replacement probability to [0, 0.92].

Zero draw, zero weight and missing inputs/genes/coordinates must return the original forecast unchanged — test all guard paths explicitly (a synthetic three-lineage probe verified seeded counts against independently computed probabilities).

H5AD round-trips can alter file format: run the harness format check before and after; off-panel Ctnnb1 reproduction requires the same released WT inputs and public test times or the mixture will not match w3_c07.
claim: Against the seed parent selected for diversity, the accepted d230 stage-match and GO-module delay will add 3.0 to 4.3 paired perturbation points. Expect roughly +1.5 to +3 de_score, +2 to +4 de_direction and +1 to +3 severity_slope skill across the board. Mef2c E8.5 should gain about 14 to 18 split points by aligning to the requested WT stage. Mab21l2 E9.5 should gain about 1 to 6 points, and its full-population severity fit should open (beta > 0 and R² > 0.01). The prediction fails if the paired board gain is below +3.0, either board DE metric fails to improve, the Mab21l2 fit stays closed, or any knockout-gene mean loses more than 0.25 points. The released-WT Ctnnb1 check must reproduce the accepted systemic delay weights and rows under the same input and seed.

title: Embryo: calibrate the midpoint pseudobulk correction on the CP10k log scale (median-centred), not on shares of total log expression
reason: Δproxy +1.29 [+1.20, +1.38] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Calibrating the embryo midpoint pseudobulk correction on the median-centred log1p(CP10k) scale instead of shares of total log expression is CONFIRMED: dproxy +1.29 [+1.20, +1.38], z +27.3, n=8, entirely from the embryo board (+2.59; heart/perturbation/temporal all 0.0). The gain is all distribution-side (distribution metrics +1.93, de_based -0.093: de_score +0.5 vs the >=+1.5 target, de_direction -1.2, variogram -2.7 breaching the -1.0 guard; mmd_u +8.5, neighborhood_mmd +3.7), so the confirmed mechanism is removing a depth double-normalisation that distorted cell distributions, not the predicted DE-ranking fix.
mechanism: In embryo.py::_shift_detected_expression the midpoint target became the plain log1p(CP10k) bracket mean (1-f)*mean_early + f*mean_late with the supported-gene test recomputed on that same scale (standard error of the mean), the residual median-centred over supported genes and divided by detection, keeping the log(2)*4f(1-f) cap; endpoints, geometry, mixture and thinning stayed byte-identical.
retry_condition: none for the shipped change (CONFIRMED); a retry aimed at the falsified DE sub-goal would need a depth-robust bracket contrast that fixes the still-reversed genes (Tbx6, Apoe, Msx2, Wnt3a) and tames depth-inflated ones (H19 +0.43 predicted vs -0.81 true) without reintroducing the share bias.
method_lessons: CP10k already normalises each cell's library size, so dividing bracket pseudobulks again by their total log expression double-normalises by detection depth (E8.0 detects 66.6 genes/cell vs 14.6 at E6.75) and pushes the late share of every moderately up-regulated gene below its early share, sign-reversing Hand1, Msx2, Wnt3a and Ntn1.

The raw CP10k log contrast tracks the true E6.75->E7.25 pseudobulk change better than the share version: Spearman +0.387 vs +0.266, sign agreement 0.92 vs 0.67 on the 39 scorer DE genes, up overlap 9/29 vs 5/29 (thinning to E6.75 depth sits between at +0.302/0.75/8/29).
A gene-uniform log offset leaves the DE ranking unchanged but costs distribution skill; median-centring the residual over supported genes removes it.

A preregistered metric signature can misattribute mechanism: only 1/5 metrics matched (mmd_u +8.5 and neighborhood_mmd +3.7 were predicted flat, de_direction -1.2 was predicted +), and the confirmed +1.29 came through the unplanned distribution channel; the DE claim was correctly declared unsupported by its own falsification rule (de_score +0.5 < +1.5) even though the change was accepted.

Diagnostic and board DE metrics can disagree: the magnitude ratio |dpred|/|dtrue| improved 0.74->0.98 and diagnostic de_score 0.156->0.219 while board de_direction fell 68.0->66.4, so a DE mechanism claim must be judged on the board metric, not the diagnostic.

On this stack the per-gene midpoint calibration target is the only DE lever because mixture weights cannot change the DE ranking (w2_c08), and the midpoint correction itself was already CONFIRMED at +0.38 (w2_c12).

Matching the scorer's 10% subsample density by emitting fewer cells is falsified: board 59.77-60.48 at n=1000-2500 vs 60.53 at 5000, neighborhood_mmd 63.5-64.2 vs 65.0, native_occupancy 0.93 vs 0.976, so N_OUT stays 5000.
No variant was tuned after seeing results and the shipped dose was the preregistered one, which is what made the 4/5 signature deviation interpretable rather than a tuning artefact.
impl_pitfalls: E7.5, the actual test stage, is permission-locked locally; contract checks must go through the harness export gate and use mirrored pairs (fraction 0.75, E7.25+E8.25_late->E8.0) instead of scoring the test pair directly.
The supported-gene test must be recomputed on the same log1p(CP10k) scale with the standard error of the mean; reusing the old share-scale test silently changes which genes get corrected.
Endpoints at fractions 0 and 1 must stay byte-identical passthrough (verified) since only interior midpoints change; the mirrored export geometry gate ratio stays 1.005-1.01.
The residual applies only to detected entries and keeps the log(2)*4f(1-f) cap, which is maximal at fraction 0.5, so the actual test pair (E7.5+E8.0->E7.75) exercises the cap at full strength.
sources: knowledge bank w2_c08 (mixture weights cannot change DE ranking)
claim: Replacing the w2_c12 share-of-total-log midpoint target with the plain log1p(CP10k) bracket midpoint, median-centred over supported genes so a gene-uniform depth offset is removed, raises embryo_early de_score by >= +1.5 and de_direction by >= +1 skill points with mmd_u, variogram and neighborhood_mmd each within -1.0, giving an embryo board gain of +0.4 to +1.5 (dproxy +0.2 to +0.75). Falsified if de_score does not rise or the board falls.

title: Heart: recover resident-cell neighborhoods on the bounded organ-radius parent
reason: Δproxy -0.08 [-0.17, +0.01] n=8; heart lower bound -0.33 not above 0.5 | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Resident-cell resampling on the bounded-radius heart parent acted exactly as designed on its targeted metrics (4/4 signature: neighborhood_mmd +1.6, mmd_u +2.7, variogram +1.1, scale flat; de_based kind +0.348) yet was still rejected: Δproxy -0.08 [-0.17, +0.01] (z -1.6, n=8) and Heart -0.15 [-0.33, +0.03] versus the preregistered +0.5 bar, because the -0.467 distribution-kind decline (E8.75 distance-shape 71.97→30.22, E9.5 occupancy Dice 44.34→39.03) outweighed the targeted gains. The seed-101 dev Heart gain of +0.89 inverted to -0.15 across the 8 prediction/fit seed pairs, showing both that single-seed dev checks overstate paired outcomes and that previously accepted components (+1.67 resident pool in w1_c04, +1.24 radius law in w1_c07) do not compose on a combined parent.
mechanism: In heart.py's dissected branch, donors were sampled from the latest input's annotated organ residents at their measured locations (existing _organ_mask, falling back to the spatial core+rim then the whole input for missing or sparse annotations), replacing the cardiac-majority crop while keeping the seeded sampler, native relative geometry, and the inherited bounded organ-radius transform.
retry_condition: Retry only if the distribution/shape cost is neutralized (e.g. admitting resident donors only where crop neighborhoods are poor, or re-anchoring shape and occupancy references to the expanded organ extent) and dev acceptance uses paired multi-seed races on targets that do not share the donor-selection label map; the near-zero CI ([-0.17, +0.01]) and the real +0.348 de_based gain mean more seed pairs could also resolve a marginal effect.
method_lessons: A confirmed 4/4 metric signature is not acceptance: targeted de_based gains (+0.348; neighborhood_mmd +1.6, mmd_u +2.7, variogram +1.1) were outweighed by a -0.467 distribution-kind decline, netting Δproxy -0.08; judge on aggregate proxy and board bars, not on the metrics the mechanism was built to move.

Single-seed dev magnitudes overstate paired outcomes: seed-101 quick_eval gave Heart +0.89 with neighborhood_mmd +6.6/+4.7 (within the predicted +2 to +7 range), but the 8-pair race gave Heart -0.15 and neighborhood_mmd +1.6.

Accepted components do not compose additively: the +1.67 Heart resident pool (w1_c04) and the +1.24 Heart radius law (w1_c07) were accepted on different parents, and their combination on the w1_c07 parent netted -0.15 Heart.

Dev targets filtered by the same annotation map used for donor selection inflate magnitudes; the preregistered risk (annotation-defined organs overstating transfer to a physical dissection with circulating or unlabeled cells) materialized.
Preregistered decision bars beat significance alone: the Heart >= +0.5 falsifier rejected cleanly while the paired proxy test by itself read inconclusive (z -1.6, CI nearly touching zero).

Exact-zero per-board deltas (embryo, temporal, perturbation all Δ=0.0, se=0) confirmed the edit stayed heart-scoped; the severity gate's five OPEN knockouts (hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18, mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41, gata4_1/2, hand2_e925) are parent-inherited knockout-response risk, unchanged by this edit.
Both plan and code critics were disabled by config, so preregistration and the paired race were the only independent checks this cycle.
impl_pitfalls: A resident donor pool contains anatomy outside the inherited cardiac crop, so frame-relative shape metrics collapse even while MMD metrics improve (E8.75 distance-shape 71.97→30.22, E9.5 occupancy Dice 44.34→39.03); always re-check shape and occupancy after expanding a donor pool.

The donor fallback chain (annotated residents → spatial core+rim → whole input) is genuinely exercised by real inputs with missing or sparse labels; test every fallback path and make output method metadata record the pool actually used.

The inherited radius cap is relative to the emitted sample (1.568×), so a pool change alters the sample the bound is measured against; scale stayed pinned (100→100, 48.66→48.66) only because this coupling held — verify it explicitly after any pool edit.
claim: Drawing from the annotated organ residents on the accepted w1_c07 radius parent will restore vascular and pericardial neighborhoods lost by the cardiac-majority crop. At each dissected dev target, expect neighborhood_mmd skill to gain about 2 to 7 points, mmd_u to gain 2 to 8, and variogram to gain 1 to 5. Preregistered falsifiers are a nonpositive neighborhood_mmd or negative split-score delta at either dissected target, or a Heart board gain below +0.5. The surrounding-tissue splits should be byte-identical. Scale skill should stay within 2 points on the dissected splits because the input organ-radius target and final bound are inherited, although the emitted sample used to realize the radius changes.

signature.summary: signature 4/4: neighborhood_mmd +ok+1.6, mmd_u +ok+2.7, variogram +ok+1.1, scale_log_ratio =ok+0.0

title: Embryo: interpolate depth-adjusted abundance in cells that detect each gene
reason: clear loss on screen: Δ-0.66 (z -10.6) | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Referencing each detection to its cell's equal-allocation depth cut gene-wise detected-abundance MAE 65% (0.503 -> 0.178, median signed error +0.371 -> -0.065) yet lost every scored distribution metric: embryo board -1.32, variogram -1.8, mmd_u -2.6, neighborhood_mmd -1.2, aggregate distribution -0.88 (proxy -0.66, z -10.6, 3/3 seed pairs negative). Marginal per-gene mean calibration is falsified as a lever on the embryo board, which rewards amplitudes and joint structure, not means.
mechanism: In embryo.py::_shift_detected_expression, replaced the w2_c12 log-share midpoint with a depth-referenced positive-abundance midpoint: subtract log1p(10000/D) (D = cell's shared-panel detection count) from each detection, interpolate gene-wise mean positive residuals between brackets by elapsed fraction, and apply the residual versus the emitted cells' own mean as a log gain clipped to the inherited log(2)*4*f*(1-f) cap, leaving donor draw, placement, thinning, warp and endpoints untouched.
retry_condition: Only if the embryo board (or a new metric) directly scores gene-wise mean detected expression, or a diagnostic shows variogram/MMD respond to marginal means once amplitudes and covariance are jointly rescaled; the preregistered falsification clause (expression error improves but distribution gains do not) was met decisively, so as a distribution lever this mechanism is dead.
method_lessons: The preregistered falsification fired exactly as designed: the mechanism beat its 25% abundance-error target by a wide margin (65% reduction) yet missed both distribution gains (at least 2 variogram points, at least 0.5 board points), so hitting an unscored intermediate target proved nothing about the scored board.

Marginal calibration does not imply joint-distribution gain: with donor draw, placement and thinning held fixed, the per-gene mean correction moved variogram -1.47, mmd_u -2.63 (breaching its 1-point guard), neighborhood_mmd -0.73 and DE direction -1.32 in the paired seed-101 run; diffs were consistent (-0.59/-0.61/-0.79, z -10.6), so this is signal, not noise.

Variogram/MMD track amplitudes and co-variation, not means: the w2_c13 direct midpoint with over-large amplitudes (median panel mass 15562 vs 10000 target) won MMD, while this amplitude-neutral mean correction lost 2.6 mmd_u points, confirming an abundance-vs-amplitude trade-off that a log-scale switch alone does not resolve.

Secondary-metric guards did their job while the primary target hid the failure: only 2/5 predicted signature checks passed (de_score, native_occupancy), and the mmd_u loss guard flagged the rejection.

Positive-entry corrections cannot fix detection-frequency errors: scarce-detection genes (Hand1, Wnt3a) kept wrong pseudobulk direction and H19 flipped to the wrong direction, consistent with Finak-style detection/abundance partitioning; treating only the abundance component leaves the frequency component binding.
impl_pitfalls: The preregistration's descriptive check and the post-run audit disagree because the dev harness computes the bracket intersection before donor thinning (241 vs 239 qualifying genes); compare abundance audits only at the same pipeline stage.
The at-least-30-positives gate (both brackets and emitted mixture) silently makes the correction a no-op for scarce genes, exactly the Hand1/Wnt3a-like cases whose pseudobulk direction stays wrong.

Occupancy invariance required explicit verification: byte-identical coordinates and detection masks were confirmed on three queries (dev, released E7.25/E8.0 halfway, later scaffold) plus unchanged native occupancy Dice 0.97605, isolating the change to positive-entry values.

The severity gate (beta>0 & R^2>0.01) left five genes OPEN (gata4_1, gata4_2, hand2_e825, hand2_e925, mef2c_e85; e.g. hand2_e825 beta 0.668, R^2 0.18, mag 1.30), flagging magnitude errors that a mean-level correction does not address.
claim: On embryo_early, replacing the w2_c12 log-share midpoint correction with a depth-adjusted positive-expression midpoint will cut mean absolute error in gene-wise mean detected expression by at least 25%, gain at least 2 variogram skill points and at least 0.5 embryo board points, with mmd_u and neighborhood_mmd each losing at most 1 point and de_score losing at most 2 points. Native occupancy must be identical. Failure to meet the variogram or board gain falsifies the proposed distribution benefit even if the expression error improves.

title: T3: express the GO-gated d230 developmental delay in units of the observed WT interval (0.23 d / 0.25 d = 0.92 interval), byte-identical at the test interval
reason: Δproxy +0.78 [+0.75, +0.82] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.287 R² 0.11 mag 0.64 OPEN; mef2c_e85 β 0.629 R² 0.75 mag 0.76 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85 | promotion review veto: Rule violation: ws/perturbation_prior_composition.py:616 - Uses the external expression prior from context['expression_prior'] to compute knockout exposure and donor weights, although external data is restricted to context['external'].; Rule violation: ws/perturbation_response_calibration.py:70 - Hard-codes the median response magnitude ratio measured on five DEV knockout targets and uses it to calibrate predictions when the mixer replaces no rows.
lesson: Expressing the GO-gated d230 developmental delay as a fixed share of the observed WT sampling interval (0.23 d / 0.25 d = 0.92) instead of absolute days lifted the perturbation board +0.78 (Δproxy [+0.75, +0.82], z +40.5, n=8; de_based +0.678, distribution +0.084, metric signature 4/4) while staying byte-identical at the 0.25-d test interval. title: Embryo: type-conditioned midpoint correction - after the global CP10k shift, move each shared cell type's detected expression toward that type's own time-proportional bracket midpoint
reason: the researcher did not change the program
lesson: Type-conditioning the global CP10k-log midpoint shift per shared cell type is not a lever on embryo: the offline paired screen gave +0.08/+0.14 board over the parent (mean +0.11, below the preregistered +0.2 falsifier, variogram -0.7 on both seeds) and the race itself was SKIPPED because the program was never changed. mmd_u/neighborhood_mmd on embryo are dominated by global detected-entry amplitude, where the parent already sits at the plateau (uniform rescale x0.7/x1.0/x1.4 -> 62.30/63.65/63.71; renormalising 61.63 or gain-centring 56.01 lose 2-8 points), so reallocating the same shift across types adds nothing.
mechanism: Proposed change (screened offline only, never raced): after the parent's global CP10k-log midpoint shift, reapply the identical estimator within each cell type shared by both brackets (>=30 cells per bracket, >=30 output rows), moving that type's detected entries toward its own time-proportional bracket midpoint, median-centred within the type and capped at log(2)*4f(1-f), with unshared labels keeping the global correction and geometry untouched.
retry_condition: Only with a different within-type target than the bracket type means, e.g. depth-matched late-bracket type means that remove E8.0's 4.6x capture-depth bias, or a diagnosis showing per-type residual misallocation after the global shift worth >0.3 board; as specified, the within-type residual is mostly the thinning offset that median-centring already removes.
method_lessons: Offline paired screens on the exact racing harness and seeds are a cheap gate: the preregistered falsifier (board change < +0.2, de_score >= +0.5) killed the idea before it consumed a race slot (de_score target met on only 1 of 2 seeds).

mmd_u and neighborhood_mmd on embryo are dominated by the global amplitude of detected entries, not its type allocation; any expression change that lowers mean detected amplitude (per-cell CP10k renormalisation 63.65 -> 61.63, gain-centring -> 56.01) loses 2-8 board points, and the parent already sits at the amplitude plateau (uniform rescale x0.7/x1.0/x1.4 -> 62.30/63.65/63.71).

Once the global gene-wise gain is applied, each shared type is already near its own bracket midpoint; the remaining within-type residual is mostly the thinning offset, which median-centring removes, so conditioning the same estimator on type adds ~nothing.

Variogram error is gene-specific spread, not a global offset: VS is approximated by the mean over pairs of (dm_i + dm_j)^2 with m_g = E sqrt(x_g) (0.0104 predicted vs 0.0102 measured), sd dm = 0.071 for the prediction vs 0.066 for copying the early bracket, so it only moves through per-gene detection x amplitude.

Amplitude at matched depth already equals the truth before the shift (6.03 vs 6.01 at 15-20 genes/cell), so the remaining expression lever is allocation, and this test bounds the type-allocation component at ~+0.1 board.
The official evidence class is SKIPPED (the researcher did not change the program); the negative conclusion rests on the offline screen, not on a raced seed pair.
impl_pitfalls: The raced program was never changed, so the cycle produced only offline diagnostics; the type pass lived in analysis/type_screen.py, not in embryo.py.
Per-type late-bracket means are measured at E8.0's 4.6x capture depth and median-centring removes only the type-uniform part, risking amplitude inflation in thinned transplants (the w2_c14 negative).
Small types yield noisy midpoints; the >=30-cells-per-bracket minimum and the 2-SE support test are needed to keep them stable.
The type pass cost -0.7 variogram on both screened seeds even while slightly helping mmd_u/neighborhood_mmd.

this cycle analysis/type_screen.py (offline paired screen, prediction seeds 101-102, scoring seeds 101-103)

title: Embryo: interpolate detected-expression spread around the CP10k midpoint
reason: Δproxy +1.68 [+1.62, +1.73] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Restoring the accepted CP10k pseudobulk mean correction plus a bracket-quantile spread warp gained +3.35 embryo board over w2_c11 (Δproxy +1.68 [+1.62, +1.73], n=8, z 54.9; neighborhood_mmd +4.3, mmd_u +10.3, all in distribution metrics), but at matched seeds the spread warp itself added only +0.02 board over the mean-only w2_c13 (63.653 -> 63.673) and missed its preregistered +0.5 variogram target (-0.043). Marginal fit did improve (centered positive-decile MAE -4.0%, 0.07721 -> 0.07415 over 282 genes, gene means preserved to 8.5e-9), so the reusable conclusion is that the mean-level CP10k midpoint correction carries the gain and the spread interpolation is a safe, near-neutral refinement, not a skill source.
mechanism: After the accepted CP10k pseudobulk mean shift on the thinned midpoint forecast, genes with at least 30 positives in each bracket and the forecast had their positive values monotonically remapped through an f-weighted interpolation of the two endpoint brackets' quantile functions on the forecast's tie-averaged empirical ranks, displacement-bounded, recentered to preserve the corrected mean exactly, and tapered by 4f(1-f); placement, coordinates, detections and the inherited state_warp tune were untouched.
retry_condition: None for the accepted combined change (CONFIRMED); the spread warp alone missed its +0.5 variogram criterion (-0.043) and barely cleared its -3% decile-MAE floor (-4.0%), so a retry needs a target with a much larger bracket-vs-released spread deficit than the ~6% IQR gap audited here (0.675 vs 0.716) and a detection-weighted decile error that actually improves (it stayed flat at 0.063).
method_lessons: Race the new mechanism against the parent that already contains every shared component: the +3.35 over w2_c11 mostly re-earned w2_c13's mean correction, and only the matched-seed race vs mean-only w2_c13 isolated the spread warp's true +0.02 board contribution.

The preregistered clause 'a win over w2_c11 alone does not confirm the spread adjustment' prevented misattributing the CONFIRMED +3.35 to the new mechanism; always pre-register the mechanism-specific comparison before running.

Marginal fit and spatial skill dissociate: centered decile MAE fell 4.0% while variogram skill fell 0.043; keep marginal (mmd_u, decile MAE) and spatial (variogram, neighborhood) success criteria separate.

Report detection-weighted and unweighted distribution errors together: unweighted decile error improved (0.072 -> 0.068 in the released audit) while detection-weighted error stayed flat at 0.063, and depth-referencing each cell made error worse, so the gain sits in low-detection genes.

Paired prediction/fit-seed evaluation (n=8) yields very tight intervals (SE 0.031, z 54.9) for aggregate verdicts, but effects as small as +0.02 board are only interpretable at matched seeds, not across seed noise.

Value-space edits leak into composition diagnostics without touching placement: composition TV fell 0.339 -> 0.318 and the Unknown fraction 27.5% -> 24.3% purely from expression recalibration, so do not treat composition outputs as invariant.

Plan and code critics were disabled by config, so no independent review points existed; preregistration, the mechanism verification (max gene-mean change 8.5e-9, identical coordinates/detection masks, predicted metric signature 3/3) and released-data contract runs were the only controls.
impl_pitfalls: The quantile warp must be recentered after aligning to the corrected detected mean or it silently destroys the accepted CP10k mean correction; assert max full-population gene-mean change stays at numerical zero (8.5e-9 achieved).
Bound the displacement and cap the taper (4f(1-f)) so every detection stays positive; unbounded quantile remaps of log-scale positive values push weak detections below the positivity floor.
Use tie-averaged empirical ranks for the warp; ordinary ranks break monotonicity of the interpolated quantile curve where intensities tie.
Gate genes on at least 30 positives in each bracket and in the forecast; sparser genes give unstable empirical quantile functions.

Exercise the hidden midpoint configuration on released data before racing: frozen dispatcher at f=0/0.5/0.75/1 must return 5,000 rows, all 498 shared genes, 5,000 distinct positions, identical coordinates and detection masks to the parent, exact endpoint reproduction of the parent's expression, and a deterministic midpoint replay through the 0.970 geometry gate (0.997 in replay, 0.9994 in the final review).

title: Heart: thin emitted real cells to the inputs' own detection-depth trend (bounded molecule thinning)
reason: Δproxy +1.20 [+1.15, +1.24] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Binomially thinning emitted molecules to the detection-depth trend fitted on the inputs themselves (organ-resident 79.6→41.1 detected genes/cell from E8.25→E9.5; thinning-only, |log change|≤0.45, horizon ≤ input span) is a confirmed heart lever: board +2.39 (Δproxy +1.20 [+1.15, +1.24], z +51.8, n=8 pairs) with both E9.5 and E8.75 targets non-negative and the predicted metric signature 5/5 (mmd_u +3.5, variogram +6.3, de_score +5.2, neighborhood_mmd +2.9, scale 0.0). Gains were distribution-led (+1.78) over de_based (+0.55) with size untouched, and post-thinning depth landed on truth (41.4 vs 41.1 organ; 38.6 vs 39.0 whole-section) — the lever is detection-domain matching, not geometry.
mechanism: heart.py now calls heart_depth.py on the final output of both sampling branches (dissected crop and surrounding-tissue copy): recover per-row molecule counts from the log1p(CP10k) lattice (expm1, divide by row minimum), fit log mean detected genes of organ-resident input cells against input time, clip the target log change to [-0.45, 0] over at most the inputs' own time span, solve one retention probability so expected detected genes match, binomially thin every row with a dedicated rng [seed, 7] and renormalise — rows, identities, coordinates and scale unchanged, and a byte-identical no-op when the inputs show no depth decline.
retry_condition: none
method_lessons: The scorer's target lives in a later, shallower detection domain than the latest input; emitting input cells at native depth misses the down-heavy truth DE set (36 up / 90 down, de_score 0.371 on heart_organ_proxy) that reference-copying cannot recover — matching the input-derived depth trend does.

Extrapolation was kept honest by damping to the inputs' own evidence: the E8.25–E8.75 fit predicts 43.1 vs true 41.1 at E9.5 and the E8.25+E8.5 fit predicts 57.4 vs true 58.6 at E8.75, so capping the horizon at the input span and |log change| at 0.45 is well-calibrated; the cap binds in practice (detected genes 40→~26, retention 0.49).

Pre-declaring the metric signature and verifying it (5/5, with scale exactly 0.0 because coordinates are untouched) is cheap confirmation that the gain came from the intended mechanism rather than a side effect.

Negative side-result worth banking: the public recipe's undecoded row-count lever is inert on heart_organ_proxy (64.6–64.9 across 1000/3000/8000/25179 rows) and hurts heart_e875_organ (77.0→74.9/75.2, occupancy 100→75–87) — row count is not the replication target, and the public recipe itself was n.s. (+0.10 in w1_c00).

Depth decline may be section batch rather than stage trend, so a latest-interval damping rule was added after the six-split dev evaluation (heart_late slope −0.307→≈−0.29); post-eval safety edits between dev and the paired test must be declared as deviations, and the no-op guard (byte-identical output when inputs show no decline) is the right failure mode for a trend-based adjustment.

Dev six-split mean (+2.75; e.g. heart_early/late 48.69→52.54) tracked the paired 8-seed result (+2.39) well, but single quick_eval runs drift slightly (heart_late 52.54 dev vs 52.30 quick_eval after the damping edit) — the paired repeated seed test is the arbiter.
impl_pitfalls: Molecule counts must be recovered before thinning is well defined: expm1(log1p(CP10k)) rows sum to 1e4 over the 500-gene panel, so divide by the row minimum to get integers (median 132 molecules/cell; 55% of nonzero entries are single molecules).
Rows that would lose every molecule keep their original observed profile — never emit all-zero rows.

Thinning needs its own rng stream ([seed, 7]) so the sampling draw, row identities and coordinates stay unchanged, and it must be applied to BOTH sampling branches — patching only the dissected crop or only the surrounding-tissue copy forfeits half the gain.
The test's target stage (E10.5) is access-gated, so the depth slope must be computed from the actual inputs at run time; keep the no-op path for when the latest interval shows no decline.
The heart_3d sanity split runs at a different log change (−0.353) than the 2D splits — 3D splits need their own sanity check rather than reusing 2D numbers.
sources: analysis/depth.py — released T2 stage depth trends (organ 79.6→41.1, region 78.5→40.1, whole section 71.5→39.0)
analysis/n_sweep.py — row-count sweep on dissected splits
diagnose.py — heart_organ_proxy truth DE set (36 up / 90 down, de_score 0.371)

claim: Heart inputs lose detection depth monotonically with stage (organ-resident detected genes/cell 79.6 -> 67.6 -> 58.6 -> 41.1 at E8.25/E8.5/E8.75/E9.5), so emitting latest-input cells at their native depth misses a global down-shift that the target shares. Binomially thinning the emitted cells' inferred molecules so the mean detected-gene count follows the log-linear depth trend fitted on the inputs (extrapolated no further than the inputs' own time span, |log change| <= 0.45, thinning only) raises the heart board by >= +0.5 (expected +1 to +3) on the paired race, with gains on BOTH targets: E9.5 splits (heart_early/late/long/organ_proxy) and E8.75 splits (heart_e875, heart_e875_organ) each non-negative. Expected movers: mmd_u +, variogram +, de_score +, neighborhood_mmd +; shape/scale metrics unchanged (= coordinates untouched). Falsified if the board gain is < +0.5 or either E8.75 split loses > 0.5.
portable: Temporal (T1) could test the same input-derived depth-trend thinning if its snRNA stages show a monotone detection trend.

title: Embryo: port the confirmed CP10k midpoint expression calibration (mean + detected spread) onto the diverse w2_c12 parent
reason: Δproxy +1.30 [+1.21, +1.39] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85 | promotion review veto: Misrepresentation: ws/embryo.py:237 - Recentring after clipping can push the applied spread adjustment past the claimed 0.5 log-unit cap, and the final update does not enforce that cap.
lesson: Third independent confirmation that replacing the share-of-total-log midpoint target with a median-centred log1p(CP10k) target raises the embryo board on this stack (Δproxy +1.30 [+1.21, +1.39], z 27.5, n=8; embryo +2.60 carried by mmd_u +8.6 / neighborhood_mmd +3.7 at a variogram cost of -2.7), yet the candidate was REJECTED on a code-honesty veto: the spread warp clips then recentres, so the final applied displacement can exceed its claimed half-log-unit cap, and the perturbation severity gate (gata4/hand2/mef2c β>0, R²>0.01) stayed open.
mechanism: In embryo.py only, the midpoint pseudobulk target was rewritten to interpolate per-gene means directly on the log1p(CP10k) scale (2-combined-SE support gate, log(2)*4*f*(1-f) gain cap, median-residual subtraction removing the gene-uniform depth offset), plus a new _interpolate_detected_spread that maps each positive intensity onto the interpolated bracket quantile function at its within-gene rank, centred and clipped, both called after donor placement and depth thinning.
retry_condition: Re-submit with the spread-warp cap enforced on the final applied update (re-clip after the displacement.mean() subtraction at ws/embryo.py:236-242, or drop the 'bounded at half a log unit' claim), and resolve the severity gate — either remediate or demonstrate inherited the open perturbation regressions (gata4_1 β0.33/R²0.17, hand2_e825 β0.67/R²0.18, mef2c_e85 β0.31/R²0.41); the measured gain (+1.30 proxy, z 27.5, n=8) already clears the performance bar, so only the implementation-honesty and cross-board-severity fixes are needed.
method_lessons: Single-seed screens overestimate: the preregistered +2.5 to +4.0 board band came from one draw (seed 101, +3.48) while the 8-pair matched-seed mean was +1.69; preregister bands from fleet races, not single draws.

Preregistered guards were breached (variogram -2.80 vs guard -1.0, de_direction -1.56 vs guard -0.5) and disclosed rather than re-dosed; the gain survives because mmd_u/neighborhood weights (0.15+0.25) exceed variogram (0.10) plus DE-direction (0.125) — a weight-aware trade-off that matched the accepted w2_c13/w2_c16 pattern, and refusing to dose-search on one seed is the right call.

Validate the pseudobulk target's sign against truth before adopting it: raw CP10k log contrast gives Spearman +0.387 / sign agreement 0.92 on the 39 scorer DE genes vs +0.266 / 0.67 for the share-of-total-log target; the 4.6x detection-depth gap (66.6 vs 14.6 genes/cell at E8.0 vs E6.75) is what flips up-regulated genes (Hand1, Msx2, Wnt3a, Ntn1) negative under share normalisation.

A stated bound must hold on the final applied update, not an intermediate one: promotion review vetoes misrepresentation regardless of measured gain, so every claim in a change plan (caps, identity-at-endpoints, byte-identical geometry) must be checked against the code path that actually writes the output.
Cross-board severity gates (β>0 & R²>0.01 on perturbation genes) can veto an embryo-only change even at z 27.5; check the perturbation board's open regressions before spending a submission slot.
impl_pitfalls: ws/embryo.py:236-242: displacement = np.clip(midpoint - values, -half_limit, half_limit) followed by displacement -= displacement.mean() lets individual entries exceed the ±log(2)/2 clip after recentring, and the final update applies strength*displacement without re-clipping — exactly the claimed-cap violation that triggered the misrepresentation veto.

The spread warp needs >=30 positive cells per gene in each input and the forecast; genes below the gate are skipped, and the warp's own board effect is tiny (+0.02 at matched seeds in w2_c16) — the mean-level CP10k step carries the gain, so port it first if a minimal diff matters.

Both new steps must be exact identities at fraction 0 and 1 and must not touch coordinates or detection masks: the export contract (bit-identical endpoints, deterministic replay at 0.5, geometry gate >=0.97 with intersected panel, three-input call returning finite non-negative 5000x498) had to be re-verified after touching only embryo.py.

Even after the sign fix, magnitudes stay under-predicted (Hand1 +0.05 predicted vs +0.82 true) because only ~29% of output cells are late donors at the midpoint fraction; the fix corrects ranking/sign and response-size ratio (0.70 -> 0.93), not per-gene magnitude.
sources: w2_c13/analysis/de_depth.py re-run on the parent workspace (detection depth 14.55/66.55/17.51 genes per cell at E6.75/E8.0/E7.25; CP10k vs share-target Spearman/sign agreement on the 39 scorer DE genes)

The gain must be carried by the distribution metrics (mmd_u +4 to +10, neighborhood_mmd +2 to +5), with de_score >= +0.5, de_direction >= -0.5 and variogram within -1.0 of the parent. title: Temporal: endocardial donor transfer capped at four points of final sampling mass
reason: Δproxy +1.85 [+1.25, +2.46] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: A myocardium-to-endocardial donor transfer dosed at half the latest observed log-odds change, bounded by one observed interval and capped at 4 points of final donor mass, gained +1.85 temporal proxy [+1.25, +2.46], z=5.8 over n=8 paired seed pairs vs parent w0_c00, with embryo/heart/perturbation deltas exactly 0.0; accepted. The gain is a pure temporal-board composition correction (temporal_val endocardial share 11.98%->14.59%, coarse TV 0.2860->0.2599) and the single-seed quick eval (+1.69 equal-weight mean) already bracketed the paired estimate.
mechanism: temporal.py adds, after chamber conditioning and before the seeded draw, a fixed-pair-mass myocardium-to-endocardial donor transfer of at most half the positive latest-interval endocardial-vs-myocardial log-odds change scaled by the elapsed fraction of one observed interval, bounded by the combined one-interval ceiling, capped at 4% of final donor mass, and applied by uniform in-place scaling within each lineage so the parent's Gaussian maturity selection is untouched.
retry_condition: none
method_lessons: Preregistered falsification gates passed cleanly (paired temporal gain +1.85 >= +1.0, lower bound +1.25 > 0); the paired n=8 race confirmed the single-seed quick-eval screen (temporal_val +1.13, temporal_heartonly +2.25, equal-weight +1.69), but only the paired test yields the per-metric signature and CI.

Solve donor-transfer caps directly in final probability mass, not raw log odds: the same idea on this parent (w0_c03) was vetoed because its raw interval was silently clipped, whereas the explicit four-point cap (budget from Turing/w3_c06, which gained +2.01) was accepted; on the three-input chamber forecast the cap demonstrably binds (uncapped half-step +0.838 log odds vs +0.635 one-interval headroom, delivered +0.434, endocardial 49.53%->53.53%).

The gain was confined to the temporal board (all eight seed-pair diffs positive, 0.73 to 3.12) with 0.0 on embryo/heart/perturbation and 0.0 by metric kind for distribution/de_based/size, so this is a temporal-protocol improvement and should not be advertised as a global distribution or DE-metric improvement.

Severity-gate OPEN flags (beta>0 & R^2>0.01 on gata4_1, gata4_2, hand2_e825, hand2_e925, mef2c_e85; largest hand2_e825 beta 0.668, R^2 0.18) coexist with an exactly-0.0 perturbation delta, i.e. they are standing parent-level relations, not regressions caused by the change; acceptance correctly keyed off the paired temporal gain.
Design and code critic verdicts ('go'/'pass') were produced with both critics disabled by config, so they carry no independent evidential weight and must not be cited as validation.
impl_pitfalls: Silent clipping of the raw transfer interval (the w0_c03 failure mode) is avoided only by computing the cap in final probability mass and auditing the delivered exchange (here exactly the 4.00-point budget, pair-mass conservation, preserved within-lineage ratios, untouched donor probabilities outside the pair).

The bundled T1 diagnostics report redirects users to aggregate quick evaluation, so donor-probability verification required a separate released-input probability audit on both dev protocols and the three-input chamber forecast.

The transfer needs explicit fallback branches for missing lineage, nonpositive observed trend, unavailable forward interval, or exhausted one-interval headroom (each keeps the parent donor law), exercised by synthetic checks covering fractional horizons, the combined one-interval limit, and flat/declining/exhausted trends.
Quick eval exposes only aggregate T1 scores; mmd_u/de_direction/de_score/variogram signature and confidence interval remain unverifiable until the full paired test runs.
claim: On w0_c00, adding the bounded myocardium-to-endocardial donor transfer should gain +1.0 to +2.5 temporal skill and aggregate proxy points in the paired race. Predict +1 to +4 skill in mmd_u and de_direction, an increase in de_score, and variogram within one skill point of the parent. Predict an increase of about 2.6 points in endocardial donor share for temporal_val and a drop of about 0.026 in coarse composition total variation. Falsified for adoption if the paired temporal gain is below +1.0 or its lower confidence bound is nonpositive. For the three-input chamber forecast, the transfer must reach the four-point probability cap while conserving the pair's total mass and leaving every donor outside the pair at its parent probability.
leaderboard_evidence: P3MIX_T1_E12p5_D50_OT50U_CB_XF (84.2) and the 81.7 two-skeleton entry support real-cell selection under composition and maturity adjustment. The current variant builds on the run's confirmed endocardial transfer.

title: T3: complete the d230 delay in WT-interval units and route its replacement through the knockout gene's own GO module
reason: clear loss on screen: Δ-3.99 (z -6.0) | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.001 R² 0.01 mag 0.16; gata4_2 β 0.001 R² -0.01 mag 0.13; hand2_e825 β 0.001 R² 0.01 mag 0.11; hand2_e925 β 0.0156 R² 0.02 mag 0.15 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.257 R² 0.15 mag 0.57 OPEN; mef2c_e85 β 0.621 R² 0.75 mag 0.76 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.00 mag 0.13 | gene-specificity -0.00 (gene-blind)
lesson: Scaling the d230 delay to the observed WT interval (DELAY_FRAC=0.92 x bracket, tripling replaced rows on Mab21l2's 0.75 d) and adding a GO-module replacement tilt is a confirmed negative: Δproxy -3.99 (z -6.0, 3/3 seed pairs negative, loss entirely de_based: de_score -3.9, de_direction -2.1, severity_slope -14.2) with gene-specificity unmoved (-0.004), so the wider dose and module routing damaged DE/severity structure instead of re-targeting it. The +2.42 seen on the single dev seed/split (mab21l2_e95, seed 101) did not generalize across seed pairs, and w3_c12's +0.78 interval-only record (different parent, never race-confirmed) did not transfer as part of this bundle.
mechanism: In perturbation_go_delay.py the absolute DELAY_DAYS=0.23 was replaced by DELAY_FRAC=0.92 of the observed WT interval (replacement dose now scales with, and varies by fit seed via, bracket width), and when the delay gate is positive each row's replacement probability is tilted by a mean-preserving (1+0.35z) toward cells expressing the knockout's kept-GO-module genes, clipped to W_MAX=0.92.
retry_condition: Only if the two arms are separated and each is validated across >=3 prediction/fit seed pairs offline before racing: re-test interval scaling alone with the effective delay capped near the incumbent 0.23 d so wide or noisy per-seed brackets cannot triple the dose, and re-test the module tilt on more than the single seed-101 module split; if interval-only also loses on paired seeds, retire the direction.
method_lessons: Single-seed dev screens mislead for de_based changes: +2.42 at seed 101 on the target split became -3.99 across 3 paired seed pairs (diffs -5.3, -3.3, -3.3); require multi-pair offline validation before racing.

The preregistered falsifier (paired board delta <= 0) fired and the predicted signature matched only 1/5 (variogram ok +0.2; severity_slope -14.2 vs a |delta|<=1 guard) — honor the preregistration; the change is falsified, not unlucky.

Gene-specificity stayed -0.004 (gene-blind): a mean-preserving odds tilt on which WT rows get replaced does not by itself make the forecast response gene-specific; the 'knockout hits its own module hardest' prior remains unvalidated.
Expressing a fixed delay as a fraction of the observed (fit-seed-dependent) bracket makes the replacement dose seed-dependent; on wide brackets dose variance, not just dose level, is the risk.

Compare arms against locally re-run baselines on the current parent, not reported numbers from other parents: the tilt was nearly deleted by comparing to 65.86 reported on w3_c11 when the local interval-only arm was 65.18.

Bundling two mechanisms (dose scaling + routing) in one race forfeits attribution: the interval-only arm's metric vector was never captured beyond severity, so the -3.99 cannot be decomposed post hoc.
impl_pitfalls: The delay path is wrapped in a total fallback (mix() returns the parent forecast on ANY exception) and no test-configuration export was run locally, so a module_row_score crash would silently degrade to parent instead of surfacing.

Component churn: the tilt was implemented, deleted after comparison to a stale reported baseline, then restored; the restore was only trusted because run 3 reproduced run 1 exactly (same score, all five metrics).
quick_eval budget left the interval-only arm with only severity beta/R^2 and total score captured, crippling post-hoc metric attribution.
Mean-preservation is enforced before the final W_MAX=0.92 clip, so ceiling-hit rows silently shrink the expected replacement total — a latent contract break in the tilt path.
claim: Two changes to the accepted d230 delay. (1) The delay is a property of the developmental interval, not of an absolute 0.23 d: expressing it as 0.92 of the observed WT bracket (DELAY_FRAC x interval) is byte-identical where the bracket is 0.25 d but scales up on wider brackets, so the narrow-module knockout Mab21l2 (E8.75->E9.5, 0.75 d) replaces 3x more later rows; predicted board gain +0.4 to +0.9 proxy, de_based only. (2) On the delay path only, the rows that are replaced are preferentially those that express the knockout gene's own vetted GO module (mean-preserving odds tilt, module expression measured in the passed WT forecast), because a knockout of a pathway member hits its own pathway hardest; predicted de_score +0.5 to +1.5 and de_direction +0.5 to +2.0 on the module-driven split (mab21l2_e95, weight 2) with severity_slope and mmd_u flat (|delta| <= 1). Falsified if the paired board delta <= 0, or if mab21l2_e95 loses, or if any non-delay split changes at all (their gate is 0 and their code path must be byte-identical).

signature.summary: signature 1/5: de_score +MISS-3.9, de_direction +MISS-2.1, severity_slope =MISS-14.2, mmd_u =MISS+2.5, variogram =ok+0.2

leaderboard_evidence: Public T3 leaders all build on the d230 real-cell delay (olivevector70 't3-x3-d230' 78.3, harbor5071 't3-r2-d230' 75.6) and the sweeps show d150 -> d230 rising monotonically in severity, mmd_u and variogram; our seed scores 68.08 with severity 88.4 but DE 60.3 and direction 62.9, so the delay is the confirmed core and the DE/direction terms are the remaining gap.

title: Heart: transfer bounded detection-depth thinning to organ-resident sampling
reason: Δproxy +1.28 [+1.24, +1.32] n=8; significant gain | severity gate (β>0 & R²>0.01): gata4_1 β 0.333 R² 0.17 mag 0.86 OPEN; gata4_2 β 0.337 R² 0.25 mag 0.68 OPEN; hand2_e825 β 0.668 R² 0.18 mag 1.30 OPEN; hand2_e925 β 0.209 R² 0.22 mag 0.57 OPEN; mab21l2_e95 β 0.001 R² -0.06 mag 0.29; mef2c_e85 β 0.31 R² 0.41 mag 0.53 OPEN; mef2c_e90 β 0.001 R² -0.03 mag 0.85
lesson: Porting the confirmed w1_c10 bounded detection-depth thinning onto the w1_c04 organ-resident parent raised paired heart skill +2.56 (Δproxy +1.28 [+1.24, +1.32], z +60.6, n=8) with the preregistered 5/5 metric signature (distribution +1.913, de_based +0.591, size 0.0) and zero movement on embryo, temporal and perturbation boards. The bounded dose (log change clipped to [-0.45, 0], horizon capped to the observed span) moved emitted depth toward targets (heart_organ_proxy 57.94 -> 43.44 vs target 41.14) but deliberately undershoots steep declines, leaving a 12.57-gene residual gap on heart_long (51.55 vs 38.98).
mechanism: After both donor-sampling paths of the w1_c04 organ-resident parent, the w1_c10 binomial thinning was applied to relative integer molecule counts inferred from the expm1 CP10k lattice, calibrated on organ-mask mean detected-gene depth over input time (shallower of fitted and latest-interval slopes, horizon capped to the observed span, log change clipped to [-0.45, 0]) using an independent RNG stream, then renormalised to log1p(CP10k) with donor draws and coordinates preserved.
retry_condition: none
method_lessons: A confirmed mechanism transferred unchanged across parents (w1_c10 +2.39 heart -> +2.56 here) with accepted bounds and no re-tuning, so preregistered transfer races on new parents are cheap, high-yield follow-ups.

Calibrate depth on protocol-matched cells: organ residents are deeper than whole sections (E9.5: 41.14 vs 38.98 detected genes/cell), so dissected targets must be compared against organ-resident depth, with an all-cells fallback when labels are sparse or missing.

Holding donor draws, row counts and coordinates fixed across arms isolates the mechanism: size gained 0.0 and scale_log_ratio stayed '=', so the proxy gain is attributable to expression depth alone, and all five preregistered metric directions matched.
Bounded dosing trades exact depth match for safety: the exp(-0.45) cap left a known, accepted 12.57-gene undershoot on heart_long rather than extrapolating beyond the observed input span.
Plan and code critics were disabled by config, so confirmation rests solely on the paired seed race plus matched-donor local checks; no adversarial review evidence exists for this record.

Heart-side depth work does not repair perturbation severity: five targets remain OPEN (e.g. hand2_e825 beta 0.668, R2 0.18) and mab21l2_e95 / mef2c_e90 have beta ~0.001 (no fit) while the perturbation board stayed at 0.0.
impl_pitfalls: The expm1/CP10k lattice is not integer-valued: counts must be inferred relative to the smallest positive entry, and rows whose counts do not fit the lattice must bypass thinning and emit the parent expression.
Thinning can empty a row; those rows must retain their original profile before renormalising, or the row is lost.
Thinning requires a dedicated independent RNG stream - sharing the donor-sampling stream breaks the bit-exact donor/coordinate match the paired race depends on.
The w1_c10 annotation regex does not exist on this parent; pass the w1_c04 organ_mask as the depth calibration mask and fall back to all cells when organ labels are unusable.
Three guard conditions must route to the parent expression path: flat or rising latest depth interval, non-forward target time, and incompatible count lattice.

With only four released stages, a five-input smoke test needs a mock fifth dissected input (organ cells from released E9.5) to verify 3,000 finite non-negative rows, coordinate preservation and same-seed reproduction.
claim: On the w1_c04 organ-resident parent, applying the confirmed w1_c10 detection-depth correction after donor sampling will increase paired heart skill by at least 0.5 points, with a non-negative mean change at each target age (E8.75 and E9.5) and on heart_long. Expected heart gain is 1–3 points, with mean neighborhood_mmd skill up 1–4, mmd_u up 1–5, variogram up 3–8, and de_score up 0–6. The same sampled positions give identical shape, occupancy and scale metrics at matched seeds. A gain below 0.5 or a loss at either age or on heart_long falsifies transfer.

signature.summary: signature 5/5: neighborhood_mmd +ok+3.2, mmd_u +ok+3.4, variogram +ok+6.6, de_score +ok+5.4, scale_log_ratio =ok+0.0
